                    latestRateTimestamp = null,

            }
    
            io.mockk.every { timeProvider.now() } returns now
    
            cashFlowCalculator = mockk<CashFlowCalculator>(relaxed = true)
            spendingThresholdCalculator = mockk<SpendingThresholdCalculator>(relaxed = true)
            coEvery { spendingThresholdCalculator.getThreshold() } returns 500.0
    
            engine = SmartSavingsEngine(
                expenseRepository = expenseRepository,
                categoryRepository = categoryRepository,
                budgetRepository = budgetRepository,
                budgetCalculator = budgetCalculator,
                monteCarloSimulator = monteCarloSimulator,

        @Test
        fun `cross currency goals are declined rather than relabeled`() = runTest {
            val goal = SavingsGoal(1L, "Trip", 1000.0, 0.0, null, GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, currency = "USD", createdAt = now)
            assertTrue(engine.calculatePortfolioRecommendations(listOf(goal), homeCurrency = "EUR").isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `excluded spending cannot create a savings recommendation`() = runTest {
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(emptyList())
            coEvery { analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(any(), any()) } returns
                com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.AnalyticsNormalizationResult(
                    "EUR", emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(), null, totalInputCount = 2
                )
            val goal = SavingsGoal(1L, "Trip", 1000.0, 0.0, null, GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now)
            assertTrue(engine.calculatePortfolioRecommendations(listOf(goal), homeCurrency = "EUR").isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `safeToSaveAmount combines weighted surplus pace and monteCarlo`() = runTest {
            val budgetStatuses = listOf(
                budgetStatus(remaining = 100.0),
                budgetStatus(remaining = 200.0),
                budgetStatus(remaining = -20.0)
            )
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(budgetStatuses)
    
            val monthExpenses = listOf(
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1001L,
                    amount = 50.0,
                    merchant = "A",
                    transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE,
                    date = now
                ),
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1002L,
                    amount = 100.0,
                    merchant = "B",
                    transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE,
                    date = now
                )
            )
            val historicalExpenses = listOf(
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1003L, amount = 600.0, merchant = "H1", categoryId = 1L, transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE, date = now),
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1004L, amount = 600.0, merchant = "H2", categoryId = 1L, transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE, date = now),
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1005L, amount = 600.0, merchant = "H3", categoryId = 1L, transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE, date = now)
            )
            coEvery { categoryRepository.getAll() } returns listOf(
                Category(id = 1L, name = "Entertainment", icon = "🎬", color = "#FF0000")
            )
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpensesBetween(any(), any()) } answers {
                val start = firstArg<Long>()
                if (start < now - (60L * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) historicalExpenses else monthExpenses
            }
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(any(), any()) } answers {
                val start = firstArg<Long>()
                if (start < now - (60L * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000))
                    historicalExpenses.map { it.toExpenseSnapshot() }
                else
                    monthExpenses.map { it.toExpenseSnapshot() }
            }
    
            coEvery { monteCarloSimulator.simulate(any(), any(), any(), any(), any()) } returns monteCarloResult(400.0)
    
            val goal = SavingsGoal(id = 0L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 5000.0, currentAmount = 1000.0, targetDate = null, protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now)
            val result = engine.calculateSafeToSaveAmount(goal, homeCurrency = "EUR")
    
            // surplus = (100 + 200) * 0.5 = 150
            // pace: totalSpent=150, day=15, projected=300, avgMonthly=1800/3=600 => (600-300)*0.3 = 90
            // mc: monthly discretionary from 3-month history = 1800/3 = 600
            //     (600 - 400*0.3) * 0.2 = 96
            // safe = 150*0.4 + 90*0.3 + 96*0.3 = 115.8
            assertApproxEquals(115.8, result.safeAmount, 0.01)
            assertApproxEquals(0.95, result.confidence, 0.001)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `monte carlo discretionary baseline excludes essential categories`() = runTest {
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(emptyList())
    
            // Month-to-date and historical requests both return this list in this test.
            val mixedExpenses = listOf(

                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1006L,
                    amount = 300.0,
                    merchant = "Supermarket",

                    transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE,
                    date = now
                ),
                // Discretionary spending (should be included)
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1007L,

                    merchant = "Cinema",
                    categoryId = 2L,
                    transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE,
                    date = now
                )
            )
    
            coEvery { categoryRepository.getAll() } returns listOf(
                Category(id = 1L, name = "Groceries", icon = "🛒", color = "#00FF00"),
                Category(id = 2L, name = "Entertainment", icon = "🎬", color = "#FF0000")
            )
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpensesBetween(any(), any()) } returns mixedExpenses
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(any(), any()) } returns mixedExpenses.map { it.toExpenseSnapshot() }
            coEvery { monteCarloSimulator.simulate(any(), any(), any(), any(), any()) } returns monteCarloResult(400.0)
    
            val result = engine.calculateSafeToSaveAmount(
                SavingsGoal(id = 0L, name = "Trip", targetAmount = 2000.0, currentAmount = 200.0, targetDate = null, protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now)
                , homeCurrency = "EUR"
            )
    
            // monthly discretionary baseline uses only discretionary purchases: 90 / 3 = 30
            assertTrue(result.isAvailable)
            // monte-carlo component => remaining = 30 - (400 * 0.3) < 0 => 0

                , homeCurrency = "EUR"

        @Test
        fun `portfolio recommendations allocate one safe amount across multiple goals`() = runTest {
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(
                listOf(budgetStatus(remaining = 300.0))
            )
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpensesBetween(any(), any()) } returns emptyList()
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(any(), any()) } returns emptyList()
            coEvery { categoryRepository.getAll() } returns emptyList()
            coEvery { monteCarloSimulator.simulate(any(), any(), any(), any(), any()) } returns null
    
            val goals = listOf(
                SavingsGoal(id = 1L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 900.0, targetDate = null, protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now),
                SavingsGoal(id = 2L, name = "Vacation", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 200.0, targetDate = null, protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now)
            )
    
            val recommendations = engine.calculatePortfolioRecommendations(goals, homeCurrency = "EUR")
    
            assertEquals(2, recommendations.size)
            assertApproxEquals(60.0, recommendations.sumOf { it.recommendation.safeAmount }, 0.01)
            // Allocation is proportional to each goal's remaining gap: 100 : 800.
            assertApproxEquals(6.666, recommendations.first { it.goal.id == 1L }.recommendation.safeAmount, 0.01)
            assertApproxEquals(53.333, recommendations.first { it.goal.id == 2L }.recommendation.safeAmount, 0.01)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `portfolio recommendations cap allocation at remaining gap`() = runTest {
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(
                listOf(budgetStatus(remaining = 2000.0))
            )
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpensesBetween(any(), any()) } returns emptyList()
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(any(), any()) } returns emptyList()
            coEvery { categoryRepository.getAll() } returns emptyList()
            coEvery { monteCarloSimulator.simulate(any(), any(), any(), any(), any()) } returns null
    
            val goals = listOf(
                SavingsGoal(id = 1L, name = "Laptop", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 990.0, targetDate = null, protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now),
                SavingsGoal(id = 2L, name = "Trip", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 995.0, targetDate = null, protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now)
            )
    
            val recommendations = engine.calculatePortfolioRecommendations(goals, homeCurrency = "EUR")
    
            assertApproxEquals(10.0, recommendations.first { it.goal.id == 1L }.recommendation.safeAmount, 0.01)
            assertApproxEquals(5.0, recommendations.first { it.goal.id == 2L }.recommendation.safeAmount, 0.01)
            assertApproxEquals(15.0, recommendations.sumOf { it.recommendation.safeAmount }, 0.01)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `budget surplus uses overall budget without stacking category budgets`() = runTest {
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(
                listOf(
                    budgetStatus(remaining = 400.0, categoryId = null),
                    budgetStatus(remaining = 150.0, categoryId = 1L),
                    budgetStatus(remaining = 100.0, categoryId = 2L)
                )
            )
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpensesBetween(any(), any()) } returns emptyList()
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(any(), any()) } returns emptyList()
            coEvery { categoryRepository.getAll() } returns emptyList()
            coEvery { monteCarloSimulator.simulate(any(), any(), any(), any(), any()) } returns null
    
            val result = engine.calculateSafeToSaveAmount(
                SavingsGoal(id = 0L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 5000.0, currentAmount = 1000.0, targetDate = null, protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now)
                , homeCurrency = "EUR"
            )
    
            assertApproxEquals(80.0, result.safeAmount, 0.01)
        }
    
        private fun budgetStatus(remaining: Double, categoryId: Long? = null): BudgetStatus {
            val budgetAmount = if (remaining > 0) remaining + 100 else 100.0
            return BudgetStatus(
                budget = Budget(categoryId = categoryId, amount = budgetAmount, period = BudgetPeriod.MONTHLY, startDate = now),
                category = null,
                spentAmount = (budgetAmount - remaining).coerceAtLeast(0.0),
                remainingAmount = remaining,
                percentUsed = 0.0f,
                healthStatus = BudgetHealthStatus.ON_TRACK,
                periodStart = now,
                periodEnd = now,
                effectiveLimit = budgetAmount
            )
        }
    
        private fun monteCarloResult(p50: Double) = MonteCarloResult(
            percentile10 = p50,
            percentile25 = p50,
            percentile50 = p50,

            percentile90 = p50,

            metadata = SimulationMetadata(0, 0, 0, 0.0, 0.0, 0, now),
            displayCurrency = "EUR"
        )
    }

         * Compute end-of-month savings sweep recommendation.
         *
         * Returns null if:
         * - Not within the recommendation window (last 5 days of month)
         * - No active budgets or no underspend
         * - No active savings goals
         * - Safe sweep amount below minimum threshold
         * - Confidence below threshold
         *
         * @return SavingsSweepRecommendation with allocation plan, or null
         */
        /**
         * Typed decision boundary. `Unavailable` is distinct from a valid empty/no-op
         * recommendation so callers cannot silently flatten failed money input to null.
         */
        suspend fun computeSweepRecommendationResult(): SavingsSweepComputationResult {
            return try {
                computeAvailableSweepRecommendation()?.let(SavingsSweepComputationResult::Available)
                    ?: SavingsSweepComputationResult.NoRecommendation
            } catch (error: MoneyDisplayUnavailableException) {
                SavingsSweepComputationResult.Unavailable(error.reasonCode.name)
            }
        }
    
        /** Compatibility adapter for legacy nullable presentation callers. */
        suspend fun computeSweepRecommendation(): SavingsSweepRecommendation? =
            (computeSweepRecommendationResult() as? SavingsSweepComputationResult.Available)?.recommendation
    
        private suspend fun computeAvailableSweepRecommendation(): SavingsSweepRecommendation? {
            val now = timeProvider.now()
            val homeCurrency = currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first()
            val rateTimestamp = currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().first()
            val targetCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                ?: return null
            // G-TIME-01: derive calendar fields from the injected TimeProvider instant
            // (java.time, system default timezone — same field values the Calendar read).
            val zone = ZoneId.systemDefault()
            val today = Instant.ofEpochMilli(now).atZone(zone).toLocalDate()
    
            // Check if we're within the recommendation window (last N days of month)
            if (!isWithinSweepWindow(today)) {
                Timber.d("Not within sweep window, skipping")
                return null
            }
    
            // Calculate month boundaries
            val daysInMonth = today.lengthOfMonth()
            val dayOfMonth = today.dayOfMonth
            val daysRemaining = daysInMonth - dayOfMonth
    
            val monthStart = today.withDayOfMonth(1).atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
            val nextMonthStart = today.withDayOfMonth(1).plusMonths(1).atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
            val monthEndInclusive = nextMonthStart - 1L
    
            // Get budget statuses and calculate underspend
            val budgetStatuses = budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses().first()
            if (budgetStatuses.any { it.isPartial || !it.percentKnown ||
                    CurrencyCode.parse(it.currency) != targetCurrency ||
                    CurrencyCode.parse(it.budget.currency) != targetCurrency }) return null
            if (budgetStatuses.isEmpty()) {
                Timber.d("No active budgets, skipping sweep")
                return null
            }
    
            val (underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent) = calculateUnderspend(budgetStatuses)
            if (underspend <= 0) {
                Timber.d("No underspend available (underspend=$underspend), skipping sweep")
                return null
            }
    
            // Calculate spent to date for Monte Carlo (normalized to home currency)
            val spentToDate = calculateSpentToDate(monthStart, now, homeCurrency)
            val knownUpcoming = calculateKnownUpcomingObligations(now, nextMonthStart, homeCurrency)
    
            // Run Monte Carlo simulation
            val monteCarloResult = monteCarloSimulator.simulate(
                spentToDate = spentToDate,
                knownUpcoming = knownUpcoming,
                budgetAmount = totalBudgeted,
                displayCurrency = homeCurrency
            )
    
            // Calculate risk buffer from Monte Carlo uncertainty
            val riskBuffer = calculateRiskBuffer(
                monteCarloResult = monteCarloResult,
                spentToDate = spentToDate,
                knownUpcoming = knownUpcoming,
                budgetAmount = totalBudgeted,
                currentDayOfMonth = dayOfMonth,
                daysRemaining = daysRemaining
            )
    
            // Calculate safe sweep amount
            val safeSweepAmount = (underspend - riskBuffer).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
            if (safeSweepAmount < MIN_SWEEP_AMOUNT) {
                Timber.d("Safe sweep amount too low ($safeSweepAmount), skipping")
                return null
            }
    
            // Get active goals
            val goals = savingsGoalRepository.observeSavingsGoals().first()
                .filter { it.targetAmount > 0.0 && it.currentAmount < it.targetAmount &&
                    CurrencyCode.parse(it.currency) == targetCurrency }
    
            if (goals.isEmpty()) {
                Timber.d("No active savings goals, skipping sweep")
                return null
            }
    
            // Calculate goal allocations
            val allocations = allocateAcrossGoals(safeSweepAmount, goals).map { it.copy(currency = homeCurrency) }
    
            // Calculate confidence score
            val confidence = calculateConfidence(
                underspend = underspend,
                riskBuffer = riskBuffer,
                monteCarloConfidence = monteCarloResult?.confidence?.score ?: 0.5,
                daysRemaining = daysRemaining,
                goalCount = goals.size
            )
    
            if (confidence < MIN_CONFIDENCE) {
                Timber.d("Confidence too low ($confidence), skipping sweep")
                return null
            }
    
            return SavingsSweepRecommendation(
                totalUnderspend = underspend,
                riskBuffer = riskBuffer,
                safeSweepAmount = safeSweepAmount,
                goalAllocations = allocations,
                computedAt = now,
                monthEnd = monthEndInclusive,
                confidence = confidence,
                currency = homeCurrency,
                rateTimestamp = rateTimestamp
            )
        }
    
        /**
         * Check if we're within the sweep recommendation window.
         * Returns true during the last [DAYS_BEFORE_MONTH_END] days of the month.
         */
        private fun isWithinSweepWindow(today: LocalDate): Boolean {
            val daysInMonth = today.lengthOfMonth()
            val dayOfMonth = today.dayOfMonth
            return dayOfMonth >= (daysInMonth - DAYS_BEFORE_MONTH_END + 1)
        }
    
        /**
         * Calculate total underspend across all budget categories.
         * Only counts remaining amounts (not overspent budgets).
         *
         * @return Triple of (underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent)
         */
        private fun calculateUnderspend(budgetStatuses: List<BudgetStatus>): Triple<Double, Double, Double> {
            val overallBudget = budgetStatuses.firstOrNull { it.budget.categoryId == null }
            val selectedStatuses = if (overallBudget != null) {
                listOf(overallBudget)
            } else {
                budgetStatuses.filter { it.budget.categoryId != null }
            }
    
            val underspend = selectedStatuses.sumOf { status ->
                status.remainingAmount.coerceAtLeast(0.0)
            }
            // T4C oracle: the sweep risk baseline uses the budgeted amount.
            // effectiveLimit is a BudgetMonitor display concept and is 0 in
            // legacy status snapshots, which would zero the budget-based
            // fallback risk buffer.
            val totalBudgeted = selectedStatuses.sumOf { it.budget.amount }
            val totalSpent = selectedStatuses.sumOf { it.spentAmount }
    
            return Triple(underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent)
        }
    
        /**

            val rawExpenses = expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(monthStart, now)
            val normalized = analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(rawExpenses, homeCurrency)
            normalized.requireCompleteMoneyInput(homeCurrency)
            // SAFE: normalized via AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer at line 220
            return normalized.includedExpenses
                .filter { it.transactionType.isSpendingType() && !it.isNotMine }
                .let { spending ->
                    normalized.completeMoneyAggregateForRows(spending, homeCurrency).displayAmount
                }
        }

        fun shouldShowSweepPrompt(): Boolean {

            val today = Instant.ofEpochMilli(now).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toLocalDate()

            configureRepositoryWithGoals(
                listOf(
                    createGoal(id = 1L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 200.0),
                    createGoal(id = 2L, name = "Vacation", targetAmount = 1500.0, currentAmount = 100.0)
                )
            )

            assertFalse(state.isLoading)
        }

    package com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.savings
    
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.model.DomainTransactionType
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.model.SavingsGoal
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Category
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.data.repository.BudgetRepository
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.data.repository.CategoryRepository
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.data.repository.ExpenseRepository
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.budget.BudgetCalculator
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.budget.BudgetStatus
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.requireCompleteMoneyInput
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.completeMoneyAggregateForRows
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.CurrencyCode
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyDisplayUnavailableException
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.cashflow.CashFlowCalculator
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyAggregateBuilder
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.SpendingThresholdCalculator
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.forecasting.MonteCarloSpendingSimulator
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.model.UiText
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.text.DomainTextKeys
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.text.UiTextArg
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.util.TimePeriodUtils
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.util.TimeProvider
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
    import javax.inject.Inject
    import javax.inject.Singleton
    
    data class SavingsRecommendation(
        val safeAmount: Double,
        val confidence: Double,
        val impact: String,
        val source: RecommendationSource,
        /** @suppress Currency code this recommendation is denominated in (e.g. "EUR", "USD"). */
        val currency: String = "",
        val isAvailable: Boolean = true
    ) {
        val moneySafeAmount: com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyAmount?
            get() = CurrencyCode.parse(currency)?.takeIf { isAvailable && it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                ?.let { com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyAmount(safeAmount, it) }
    }
    
    data class GoalSavingsRecommendation(
        val goal: SavingsGoal,
        val recommendation: SavingsRecommendation
    )
    
    enum class RecommendationSource {
        BUDGET_SURPLUS,
        SPENDING_PACE,
        MONTE_CARLO,
        INCOME_DEPOSIT,
        ROUND_UP
    }
    
    @Singleton
    class SmartSavingsEngine @Inject constructor(
        private val expenseRepository: ExpenseRepository,
        private val categoryRepository: CategoryRepository,
        private val budgetRepository: BudgetRepository,
        private val budgetCalculator: BudgetCalculator,
        private val monteCarloSimulator: MonteCarloSpendingSimulator,
        private val timeProvider: TimeProvider,
        private val analyticsCurrencyNormalizer: AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer,
        /** AI-4: CashFlowCalculator provides the canonical list of upcoming recurring obligations. */
        private val cashFlowCalculator: CashFlowCalculator,
        /** AIML-30: SpendingThresholdCalculator for adaptive caps instead of hardcoded values. */
        private val spendingThresholdCalculator: SpendingThresholdCalculator
    ) {
        companion object {
            private const val DAY_IN_MILLIS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L
    
            /**
             * Default weekly safe-save cap, denominated in the user's home currency.
             *
             * These caps represent conservative upper bounds on how much the engine
             * will recommend saving in a single week/month/quarter. They prevent
             * overly aggressive savings recommendations. Values are in home-currency
             * units (e.g., EUR, USD) and should be tuned per-market. Future iterations
             * may expose these as user-editable settings via [CurrencySettingsRepository].
             */
            /**
             * Fallback monthly discretionary spending used when historical data is
             * insufficient to compute a user-specific baseline. Denominated in home
             * currency.
             */
            private const val DEFAULT_FALLBACK_MONTHLY_DISCRETIONARY = 500.0
        }
    
        suspend fun calculateSafeToSaveAmount(
            goal: SavingsGoal,
            timeHorizon: TimeHorizon = TimeHorizon.MONTH,
            homeCurrency: String
        ): SavingsRecommendation {
            return calculatePortfolioRecommendations(listOf(goal), timeHorizon, homeCurrency)
                .firstOrNull()
                ?.recommendation
                ?: SavingsRecommendation(
                    safeAmount = 0.0,
                    confidence = 0.0,
                    impact = "Savings recommendation unavailable",
                    source = RecommendationSource.BUDGET_SURPLUS,
                    currency = homeCurrency,
                    isAvailable = false
                )
        }
    
        suspend fun calculatePortfolioRecommendations(
            goals: List<SavingsGoal>,
            timeHorizon: TimeHorizon = TimeHorizon.MONTH,
            homeCurrency: String
        ): List<GoalSavingsRecommendation> {
            val targetCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                ?: return emptyList()
            val incompleteGoals = goals.filter { goal ->
                (goal.targetAmount - goal.currentAmount) > 0.0 &&
                    CurrencyCode.parse(goal.currency) == targetCurrency
            }
    
            if (incompleteGoals.isEmpty()) {
                return emptyList()
            }
    
            val portfolioRecommendation = try { calculatePortfolioSafeToSaveAmount(
                sampleGoal = incompleteGoals.first(),
                timeHorizon = timeHorizon,
                homeCurrency = homeCurrency
            ) } catch (error: MoneyDisplayUnavailableException) {
                return emptyList()
            }
            val allocations = allocateAcrossGoals(incompleteGoals, portfolioRecommendation.safeAmount)
    
            return incompleteGoals.mapIndexed { index, goal ->
                val allocatedAmount = allocations.getOrElse(index) { 0.0 }
                GoalSavingsRecommendation(
                    goal = goal,
                    recommendation = portfolioRecommendation.copy(
                        safeAmount = allocatedAmount,
                        impact = generateImpactMessage(allocatedAmount, goal, timeHorizon, homeCurrency)
                    )
                )
            }
        }
    
        private fun calculateBudgetSurplus(budgetStatuses: List<BudgetStatus>): Double {
            val scopedStatuses = budgetStatuses
                .let { allStatuses ->
                    val overallStatuses = allStatuses.filter { it.budget.categoryId == null }
                    if (overallStatuses.isNotEmpty()) overallStatuses else allStatuses
                }
                .filter { it.remainingAmount > 0.0 }
    
            var totalSurplus = 0.0
            for (status in scopedStatuses) {
                // Only count 50% of surplus to be conservative
                totalSurplus += status.remainingAmount * 0.5
            }
            return totalSurplus
        }
    
        private suspend fun calculatePortfolioSafeToSaveAmount(
            sampleGoal: SavingsGoal,
            timeHorizon: TimeHorizon,
            homeCurrency: String
        ): SavingsRecommendation {
            val now = timeProvider.now()
            val budgetStatuses = budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses().first()
            if (budgetStatuses.any { it.isPartial || !it.percentKnown ||
                    CurrencyCode.parse(it.currency) != CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency) }) {
                throw MoneyDisplayUnavailableException(
                    com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE
                )
            }
    
            val budgetSurplus = calculateBudgetSurplus(budgetStatuses)
            val spendingPace = analyzeSpendingPace(timeHorizon, homeCurrency)
            val monteCarloResult = runMonteCarloSimulation(sampleGoal, now, timeHorizon, homeCurrency)
            val safeAmount = calculateWeightedSafeAmount(
                budgetSurplus = budgetSurplus,
                spendingPace = spendingPace,
                monteCarloResult = monteCarloResult,
                timeHorizon = timeHorizon,
                homeCurrency = homeCurrency
            )
    
            return SavingsRecommendation(
                safeAmount = safeAmount,
                confidence = calculateConfidence(budgetSurplus, spendingPace, monteCarloResult),
                impact = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_PORTFOLIO_RECOMMENDATION_READY).asFallbackString(),
                source = determinePrimarySource(budgetSurplus, spendingPace, monteCarloResult),
                currency = homeCurrency
            )
        }
    
        private fun allocateAcrossGoals(
            goals: List<SavingsGoal>,
            totalSafeAmount: Double
        ): List<Double> {
            if (goals.isEmpty() || totalSafeAmount <= 0.0) {
                return List(goals.size) { 0.0 }
            }
    
            val allocations = MutableList(goals.size) { 0.0 }
            val remainingGaps = goals
                .map { (it.targetAmount - it.currentAmount).coerceAtLeast(0.0) }
                .toMutableList()
            val weights = goals.map { calculateAllocationWeight(it) }
            var remainingSafeAmount = totalSafeAmount
            val activeIndexes = goals.indices.toMutableSet()
    
            while (remainingSafeAmount > 0.01 && activeIndexes.isNotEmpty()) {
                val totalWeight = activeIndexes.sumOf { index -> weights[index] }
                if (totalWeight <= 0.0) {
                    break
                }
    
                var allocatedThisRound = 0.0
                val filledIndexes = mutableSetOf<Int>()
                for (index in activeIndexes) {
                    val proposedAmount = remainingSafeAmount * (weights[index] / totalWeight)
                    val cappedAmount = minOf(proposedAmount, remainingGaps[index])
                    if (cappedAmount > 0.0) {
                        allocations[index] += cappedAmount
                        remainingGaps[index] -= cappedAmount
                        allocatedThisRound += cappedAmount
                    }
                    if (remainingGaps[index] <= 0.01) {
                        filledIndexes += index
                    }
                }
    
                if (allocatedThisRound <= 0.0) {
                    break
                }
    
                remainingSafeAmount -= allocatedThisRound
                activeIndexes.removeAll(filledIndexes)
            }
    
            return allocations.mapIndexed { index, amount ->
                amount.coerceAtMost((goals[index].targetAmount - goals[index].currentAmount).coerceAtLeast(0.0))
            }
        }
    
        private fun calculateAllocationWeight(goal: SavingsGoal): Double {
            val remainingGap = (goal.targetAmount - goal.currentAmount).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
            if (remainingGap <= 0.0) {
                return 0.0
            }
    
            val urgencyMultiplier = goal.targetDate?.let { targetDate ->
                val millisUntilTarget = targetDate - timeProvider.now()
                val daysUntilTarget = millisUntilTarget / (24.0 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
                when {
                    daysUntilTarget <= 30.0 -> 2.0
                    daysUntilTarget <= 90.0 -> 1.5
                    daysUntilTarget <= 180.0 -> 1.25
                    else -> 1.0
                }
            } ?: 1.0
    
            return remainingGap * urgencyMultiplier
        }
    
        private suspend fun analyzeSpendingPace(timeHorizon: TimeHorizon, homeCurrency: String): Double {
            val now = timeProvider.now()
            val dayOfMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getDayOfMonth(now).coerceAtLeast(1)
            val daysInMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getDaysInMonth(now)
    
            // Get current month's spending (normalized to home currency)
            val monthStart = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfMonth(now)
    
            val rawExpenses = expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(monthStart, now)
            val normalized = analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(rawExpenses, homeCurrency)
            normalized.requireCompleteMoneyInput(homeCurrency)
            val expenses = normalized.includedExpenses
            // SAFE: data normalized via AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer at line 231
            val totalSpent = expenses
                .filter { it.transactionType == DomainTransactionType.PURCHASE && !it.isNotMine }
                .let { purchases ->

     145:     private fun calculateBudgetSurplus(budgetStatuses: List<BudgetStatus>): Double {
     146:         val scopedStatuses = budgetStatuses
     147:             .let { allStatuses ->
     148:                 val overallStatuses = allStatuses.filter { it.budget.categoryId == null }
     149:                 if (overallStatuses.isNotEmpty()) overallStatuses else allStatuses

     151:             .filter { it.remainingAmount > 0.0 }
     152:
     153:         var totalSurplus = 0.0
     154:         for (status in scopedStatuses) {
     155:             // Only count 50% of surplus to be conservative
     156:             totalSurplus += status.remainingAmount * 0.5
     157:         }
     158:         return totalSurplus
     159:     }

     195:     private fun allocateAcrossGoals(
     196:         goals: List<SavingsGoal>,
     197:         totalSafeAmount: Double
     198:     ): List<Double> {
     199:         if (goals.isEmpty() || totalSafeAmount <= 0.0) {
     200:             return List(goals.size) { 0.0 }
     201:         }
     202:
     203:         val allocations = MutableList(goals.size) { 0.0 }
     204:         val remainingGaps = goals
     205:             .map { (it.targetAmount - it.currentAmount).coerceAtLeast(0.0) }
     206:             .toMutableList()
     207:         val weights = goals.map { calculateAllocationWeight(it) }
     208:         var remainingSafeAmount = totalSafeAmount
     209:         val activeIndexes = goals.indices.toMutableSet()
     210:
     211:         while (remainingSafeAmount > 0.01 && activeIndexes.isNotEmpty()) {
     212:             val totalWeight = activeIndexes.sumOf { index -> weights[index] }
     213:             if (totalWeight <= 0.0) {
     214:                 break
     215:             }
     216:
     217:             var allocatedThisRound = 0.0
     218:             val filledIndexes = mutableSetOf<Int>()
     219:             for (index in activeIndexes) {
     220:                 val proposedAmount = remainingSafeAmount * (weights[index] / totalWeight)
     221:                 val cappedAmount = minOf(proposedAmount, remainingGaps[index])
     222:                 if (cappedAmount > 0.0) {
     223:                     allocations[index] += cappedAmount
     224:                     remainingGaps[index] -= cappedAmount
     225:                     allocatedThisRound += cappedAmount
     226:                 }
     227:                 if (remainingGaps[index] <= 0.01) {
     228:                     filledIndexes += index
     229:                 }
     230:             }
     231:
     232:             if (allocatedThisRound <= 0.0) {
     233:                 break
     234:             }
     235:
     236:             remainingSafeAmount -= allocatedThisRound
     237:             activeIndexes.removeAll(filledIndexes)
     238:         }
     239:
     240:         return allocations.mapIndexed { index, amount ->
     241:             amount.coerceAtMost((goals[index].targetAmount - goals[index].currentAmount).coerceAtLeast(0.0))
     242:         }
     243:     }

     245:     private fun calculateAllocationWeight(goal: SavingsGoal): Double {
     246:         val remainingGap = (goal.targetAmount - goal.currentAmount).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
     247:         if (remainingGap <= 0.0) {
     248:             return 0.0

     254:             when {

      37:  * 1. Budget underspend across all categories

     218:     /**

     221:      */
     222:     private fun isWithinSweepWindow(today: LocalDate): Boolean {
     223:         val daysInMonth = today.lengthOfMonth()
     224:         val dayOfMonth = today.dayOfMonth

     228:     /**
     229:      * Calculate total underspend across all budget categories.
     230:      * Only counts remaining amounts (not overspent budgets).
     231:      *
     232:      * @return Triple of (underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent)
     233:      */
     234:     private fun calculateUnderspend(budgetStatuses: List<BudgetStatus>): Triple<Double, Double, Double> {
     235:         val overallBudget = budgetStatuses.firstOrNull { it.budget.categoryId == null }
     236:         val selectedStatuses = if (overallBudget != null) {
     237:             listOf(overallBudget)
     238:         } else {
     239:             budgetStatuses.filter { it.budget.categoryId != null }
     240:         }
     241:
     242:         val underspend = selectedStatuses.sumOf { status ->
     243:             status.remainingAmount.coerceAtLeast(0.0)
     244:         }
     245:         // T4C oracle: the sweep risk baseline uses the budgeted amount.
     246:         // effectiveLimit is a BudgetMonitor display concept and is 0 in
     247:         // legacy status snapshots, which would zero the budget-based
     248:         // fallback risk buffer.
     249:         val totalBudgeted = selectedStatuses.sumOf { it.budget.amount }
     250:         val totalSpent = selectedStatuses.sumOf { it.spentAmount }
     251:
     252:         return Triple(underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent)
     253:     }

     313:     /**
     314:      * Calculate risk buffer from Monte Carlo uncertainty.
     315:      * Uses the spread between p75 and p50 as a conservative uncertainty buffer.
     316:      */
     317:     private fun calculateRiskBuffer(
     318:         monteCarloResult: com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.forecasting.MonteCarloResult?,
     319:         spentToDate: Double,
     320:         knownUpcoming: Double,
     321:         budgetAmount: Double,
     322:         currentDayOfMonth: Int,
     323:         daysRemaining: Int
     324:     ): Double {
     325:         if (monteCarloResult == null) {
     326:             val safeCurrentDay = currentDayOfMonth.coerceAtLeast(1)
     327:             val currentDailySpend = spentToDate / safeCurrentDay
     328:             val projectedRemainingSpend = currentDailySpend * daysRemaining.coerceAtLeast(0)
     329:             val baselineBuffer = maxOf(
     330:                 knownUpcoming * 0.15,
     331:                 projectedRemainingSpend * 0.20,
     332:                 budgetAmount * 0.03
     333:             )
     334:             val maxFallbackBuffer = maxOf(knownUpcoming, budgetAmount * 0.25)
     335:             return baselineBuffer.coerceIn(0.0, maxFallbackBuffer)
     336:         }
     337:
     338:         // Risk buffer = p75 - p50 (uncertainty in the upper range)
     339:         val buffer = monteCarloResult.percentile75 - monteCarloResult.percentile50
     340:
     341:         // Apply a cap to prevent overly conservative estimates
     342:         val maxBuffer = monteCarloResult.percentile50 * 0.3 // Max 30% of median projection
     343:
     344:         return buffer.coerceIn(0.0, maxBuffer)
     345:     }

     347:     /**
     348:      * Distribute safe sweep amount across active goals proportionally
     349:      * based on urgency (how far from target).
     350:      *
     351:      * Allocation formula:
     352:      * - urgency = 1.0 - (currentAmount / targetAmount)
     353:      * - percentage = urgency / totalUrgency
     354:      * - allocation = safeSweepAmount * percentage
     355:      */

     360:         data class GoalAllocationState(

     371:                 goal = goal,
     372:                 urgency = (1.0 - progress).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0),
     373:                 remainingGap = remainingGap

     383:         do {
     384:             madeProgress = false
     385:             val openStates = states.filter {
     386:                 it.remainingGap - it.allocated > 0.0 &&
     387:                     maxAllocation - it.allocated > 0.0
     388:             }
     389:             if (openStates.isEmpty() || remainingSweep <= 0.0) break
     390:
     391:             val totalUrgency = openStates.sumOf { it.urgency }
     392:             val equalWeight = if (openStates.isNotEmpty()) 1.0 / openStates.size else 0.0
     393:
     394:             openStates.forEachIndexed { index, state ->
     395:                 if (remainingSweep <= 0.0) return@forEachIndexed
     396:
     397:                 val weight = if (totalUrgency > 0.0) state.urgency / totalUrgency else equalWeight
     398:                 val provisionalShare = if (index == openStates.lastIndex) {
     399:                     remainingSweep
     400:                 } else {
     401:                     remainingSweep * weight
     402:                 }
     403:                 val gapCapped = provisionalShare.coerceAtMost(state.remainingGap - state.allocated)
     404:                 val concentrationCapped = gapCapped.coerceAtMost(maxAllocation - state.allocated)
     405:
     406:                 if (concentrationCapped > 0.0) {
     407:                     state.allocated += concentrationCapped
     408:                     remainingSweep -= concentrationCapped
     409:                     madeProgress = true
     410:                 }
     411:             }
     412:         } while (madeProgress)
     413:
     414:         return states
     415:             .filter { it.allocated > 0.0 }
     416:             .map { state ->
     417:                 GoalAllocation(
     418:                     goalId = state.goal.id,
     419:                     goalName = state.goal.name,
     420:                     currentProgress = state.goal.currentAmount,
     421:                     targetAmount = state.goal.targetAmount,
     422:                     suggestedAllocation = state.allocated,
     423:                     allocationPercentage = if (safeSweepAmount > 0.0) state.allocated / safeSweepAmount else 0.0
     424:                 )
     425:             }
     426:             .sortedByDescending { it.suggestedAllocation }
     427:     }

     429:     /**
     430:      * Calculate overall confidence score for the recommendation.
     431:      */
     432:     private fun calculateConfidence(
     433:         underspend: Double,
     434:         riskBuffer: Double,
     435:         monteCarloConfidence: Double,
     436:         daysRemaining: Int,
     437:         goalCount: Int
     438:     ): Double {
     439:         var score = 0.0
     440:
     441:         // Base confidence from Monte Carlo
     442:         score += monteCarloConfidence * 0.4
     443:
     444:         // Higher confidence when risk buffer is small relative to underspend
     445:         val bufferRatio = if (underspend > 0) riskBuffer / underspend else 1.0
     446:         score += (1.0 - bufferRatio.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)) * 0.3
     447:
     448:         // Higher confidence closer to month end (less uncertainty)
     449:         val dayConfidence = if (daysRemaining <= 2) 0.2 else if (daysRemaining <= 5) 0.1 else 0.0
     450:         score += dayConfidence
     451:
     452:         // Having multiple goals slightly increases confidence (diversification)
     453:         if (goalCount >= 2) {
     454:             score += 0.1
     455:         }
     456:
     457:         return score.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
     458:     }

     466:         val today = Instant.ofEpochMilli(now).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toLocalDate()
     467:         return isWithinSweepWindow(today)

    import kotlin.reflect.KClass
    
    /**
     * Contract test ensuring every DashboardWidget subclass is explicitly handled
     * in the HomeScreen render block.
     *
     * When a new DashboardWidget variant is added, this test fails until the
     * developer adds it to the RENDERED_WIDGETS set â€” forcing them to also
     * add render logic in HomeScreen.
     */
    class DashboardWidgetRenderCoverageTest {
    
        /**
         * Every DashboardWidget subclass that has render logic in HomeScreen.
         * Update this set when adding a new widget AND its render code.
         */
        private val RENDERED_WIDGETS: Set<KClass<out DashboardWidget>> = setOf(
            DashboardWidget.SafeToSpend::class,
            DashboardWidget.BudgetBlockParty::class,
            DashboardWidget.SpendingPaceWidget::class,
            DashboardWidget.PendingReviewAlert::class,
            DashboardWidget.PeriodSummary::class,
            DashboardWidget.TopCategories::class,
            DashboardWidget.BudgetHealthWidget::class,
            DashboardWidget.RecentTransactions::class,
            DashboardWidget.NaturalLanguageInsight::class,
            DashboardWidget.SpendingTrend::class,
            DashboardWidget.FinancialWeatherWidget::class,
            DashboardWidget.FinancialRunway::class,
            DashboardWidget.MonteCarloForecast::class,
            DashboardWidget.TotalsDashboard::class,
            DashboardWidget.NoSpendStreak::class,
            DashboardWidget.FinancialHealthScoreWidget::class,
            DashboardWidget.FinancialHealthScoreV2Widget::class,
            DashboardWidget.LifestyleSavingsPrompt::class,
            DashboardWidget.SavingsSweepPrompt::class,
            DashboardWidget.MoneyRadar::class,
            DashboardWidget.FinancialStressForecast::class
        )
    
        @Test
        fun `all DashboardWidget subclasses have render coverage`() {
            val sealedSubclasses = DashboardWidget::class.sealedSubclasses
            val missing = sealedSubclasses.filter { it !in RENDERED_WIDGETS }
    
            assertTrue(
                "New DashboardWidget subclass(es) without render coverage: " +
                "${missing.map { it.simpleName }}. " +
                "Add render logic in HomeScreen AND add to RENDERED_WIDGETS in this test.",
                missing.isEmpty()
            )
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `RENDERED_WIDGETS does not contain stale entries`() {
            val sealedSubclasses = DashboardWidget::class.sealedSubclasses.toSet()
            val stale = RENDERED_WIDGETS.filter { it !in sealedSubclasses }
    
            assertTrue(
                "Stale entries in RENDERED_WIDGETS (widget removed but test not updated): " +
                "${stale.map { it.simpleName }}",
                stale.isEmpty()
            )
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `widget count matches expected`() {
            val count = DashboardWidget::class.sealedSubclasses.size
            assertEquals(
                "DashboardWidget subclass count changed. Update RENDERED_WIDGETS.",
                21, count
            )
        }
    }

        @Test
        fun `cross currency goals are declined rather than relabeled`() = runTest {
            val goal = SavingsGoal(1L, "Trip", 1000.0, 0.0, null, GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, currency = "USD", createdAt = now)
            assertTrue(engine.calculatePortfolioRecommendations(listOf(goal), homeCurrency = "EUR").isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `excluded spending cannot create a savings recommendation`() = runTest {
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(emptyList())
            coEvery { analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(any(), any()) } returns
                com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.AnalyticsNormalizationResult(
                    "EUR", emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(), null, totalInputCount = 2
                )
            val goal = SavingsGoal(1L, "Trip", 1000.0, 0.0, null, GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now)
            assertTrue(engine.calculatePortfolioRecommendations(listOf(goal), homeCurrency = "EUR").isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `safeToSaveAmount combines weighted surplus pace and monteCarlo`() = runTest {
            val budgetStatuses = listOf(
                budgetStatus(remaining = 100.0),
                budgetStatus(remaining = 200.0),
                budgetStatus(remaining = -20.0)
            )
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(budgetStatuses)
    
            val monthExpenses = listOf(
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1001L,
                    amount = 50.0,
                    merchant = "A",
                    transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE,
                    date = now
                ),
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1002L,
                    amount = 100.0,
                    merchant = "B",
                    transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE,
                    date = now
                )
            )
            val historicalExpenses = listOf(
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1003L, amount = 600.0, merchant = "H1", categoryId = 1L, transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE, date = now),
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1004L, amount = 600.0, merchant = "H2", categoryId = 1L, transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE, date = now),
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1005L, amount = 600.0, merchant = "H3", categoryId = 1L, transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE, date = now)
            )
            coEvery { categoryRepository.getAll() } returns listOf(
                Category(id = 1L, name = "Entertainment", icon = "ðŸŽ¬", color = "#FF0000")
            )
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpensesBetween(any(), any()) } answers {
                val start = firstArg<Long>()
                if (start < now - (60L * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) historicalExpenses else monthExpenses
            }
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(any(), any()) } answers {
                val start = firstArg<Long>()
                if (start < now - (60L * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000))
                    historicalExpenses.map { it.toExpenseSnapshot() }
                else
                    monthExpenses.map { it.toExpenseSnapshot() }
            }
    
            coEvery { monteCarloSimulator.simulate(any(), any(), any(), any(), any()) } returns monteCarloResult(400.0)
    
            val goal = SavingsGoal(id = 0L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 5000.0, currentAmount = 1000.0, targetDate = null, protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now)
            val result = engine.calculateSafeToSaveAmount(goal, homeCurrency = "EUR")
    
            // surplus = (100 + 200) * 0.5 = 150
            // pace: totalSpent=150, day=15, projected=300, avgMonthly=1800/3=600 => (600-300)*0.3 = 90
            // mc: monthly discretionary from 3-month history = 1800/3 = 600
            //     (600 - 400*0.3) * 0.2 = 96
            // safe = 150*0.4 + 90*0.3 + 96*0.3 = 115.8
            assertApproxEquals(115.8, result.safeAmount, 0.01)
            assertApproxEquals(0.95, result.confidence, 0.001)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `monte carlo discretionary baseline excludes essential categories`() = runTest {
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(emptyList())
    
            // Month-to-date and historical requests both return this list in this test.
            val mixedExpenses = listOf(
                // Essential spending (should be excluded from discretionary baseline)
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1006L,
                    amount = 300.0,
                    merchant = "Supermarket",
                    categoryId = 1L,
                    transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE,
                    date = now
                ),
                // Discretionary spending (should be included)
                com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.Expense(id = 1007L,
                    amount = 90.0,
                    merchant = "Cinema",
                    categoryId = 2L,
                    transactionType = TransactionType.PURCHASE,
                    date = now
                )
            )
    
            coEvery { categoryRepository.getAll() } returns listOf(
                Category(id = 1L, name = "Groceries", icon = "ðŸ›’", color = "#00FF00"),
                Category(id = 2L, name = "Entertainment", icon = "ðŸŽ¬", color = "#FF0000")
            )
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpensesBetween(any(), any()) } returns mixedExpenses
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(any(), any()) } returns mixedExpenses.map { it.toExpenseSnapshot() }
            coEvery { monteCarloSimulator.simulate(any(), any(), any(), any(), any()) } returns monteCarloResult(400.0)
    
            val result = engine.calculateSafeToSaveAmount(
                SavingsGoal(id = 0L, name = "Trip", targetAmount = 2000.0, currentAmount = 200.0, targetDate = null, protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now)
                , homeCurrency = "EUR"
            )
    
            // monthly discretionary baseline uses only discretionary purchases: 90 / 3 = 30
            assertTrue(result.isAvailable)
            // monte-carlo component => remaining = 30 - (400 * 0.3) < 0 => 0
            // pace also 0 (projected above baseline), budget surplus 0 => safe amount 0
            assertApproxEquals(0.0, result.safeAmount)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `no budgets and no spending history return zero safe amount`() = runTest {
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(emptyList())
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpensesBetween(any(), any()) } returns emptyList()
            coEvery { expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(any(), any()) } returns emptyList()

            val result = engine.calculateSafeToSaveAmount(

                , homeCurrency = "EUR"
            )
    
            assertApproxEquals(0.0, result.safeAmount)

            coEvery { monteCarloSimulator.simulate(any(), any(), any(), any(), any()) } returns monteCarloResult(5000.0)
    
            val result = engine.calculateSafeToSaveAmount(

                , homeCurrency = "EUR"

    package com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money
    
    /**
     * CURR-587-01: Typed result for money aggregation operations.
     *
     * Unavailable state is explicit â€” no fake/sentinel currency.
     * MoneyAggregate continues to mean "available aggregate with a valid display currency".
     */
    sealed interface MoneyAggregateResult {
        data class Available(
            val aggregate: MoneyAggregate
        ) : MoneyAggregateResult
    
        data class Unavailable(
            val reason: String,
            val requestedRateBasis: RateBasis,
            val metadata: MoneyAggregateMetadata = MoneyAggregateMetadata(),
            val warningMessage: String = reason
        ) : MoneyAggregateResult
    }
    
    enum class MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode {
        INVALID_TARGET_CURRENCY,
        INVALID_SOURCE_CURRENCY,
        INVALID_AMOUNT,
        INVALID_TRANSACTION_COUNTS,
        DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE,
        HOME_CURRENCY_UNAVAILABLE
    }
    
    class MoneyDisplayUnavailableException(
        val reasonCode: MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode
    ) : IllegalStateException(reasonCode.name)
    
    val MoneyAggregateResult.isAvailable: Boolean
        get() = this is MoneyAggregateResult.Available
    
    val MoneyAggregateResult.isUnavailable: Boolean
        get() = this is MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable
    
    fun MoneyAggregateResult.aggregateOrNull(): MoneyAggregate? =
        (this as? MoneyAggregateResult.Available)?.aggregate
    
    fun MoneyAggregateResult.warningOrNull(): String? = when (this) {
        is MoneyAggregateResult.Available -> aggregate.warningMessage
        is MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable -> warningMessage
    }
    
    fun MoneyAggregateResult.requireDisplayAmount(): Double = when (this) {
        is MoneyAggregateResult.Available -> aggregate.displayAmount
        is MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable -> throw MoneyDisplayUnavailableException(
            MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == reason }
                ?: MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE
        )
    }

     471:             }
     472:         val endOfLastCompleteMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfMonth(now) - 1L
     473:         val lookbackMonthCount = countCalendarMonthsInRange(

     475:             endInclusive = endOfLastCompleteMonth
     476:         )
     477:         val monthlyDiscretionary = if (lookbackMonthCount > 0) {

     486:         } else {
     487:             0.0
     488:         }

     490:         // AI-4: Calculate known upcoming obligations from CashFlowCalculator using
     491:         // occurrence-driven recurring rules + planned expenses (deduplicated).
     492:         val daysRemainingInMonth = TimePeriodUtils.daysBetween(now, TimePeriodUtils.getEndOfMonth(now))
     493:         val daysRemaining = daysRemainingInMonth.coerceAtLeast(1)
     494:         val upcomingPatterns = cashFlowCalculator.getUpcomingBills(daysAhead = daysRemaining)
     495:         if (upcomingPatterns.any { CurrencyCode.parse(it.currency) != CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency) }) {
     496:             throw MoneyDisplayUnavailableException(
     497:                 com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE
     498:             )
     499:         }

     501:             upcomingPatterns.map { it.averageAmount }, homeCurrency
     502:         ).displayAmount
     503:         // FCST-4: Compute an estimated weekly recurring amount from the upcoming patterns
     504:         // so the Monte Carlo simulator can subtract recurring spend from its stochastic
     505:         // sampling and avoid double-counting with knownUpcoming.
     506:         val estimatedWeeklyRecurring = if (daysRemaining > 0) {
     507:             knownUpcoming / (daysRemaining / 7.0)
     508:         } else 0.0
     509:         val monthlyResult = monteCarloSimulator.simulate(
     510:             spentToDate = monthSpentToDate,
     511:             knownUpcoming = knownUpcoming,
     512:             budgetAmount = null, // No budget constraint
     513:             displayCurrency = homeCurrency,
     514:             estimatedWeeklyRecurring = estimatedWeeklyRecurring
     515:         )

     517:         val projectedHorizonSpending = when (timeHorizon) {
     518:             TimeHorizon.WEEK -> simulateWeeklyProjectedSpending(now, averageHistoricalDailySpending, homeCurrency)
     519:             TimeHorizon.MONTH -> monthlyResult?.percentile50
     520:                 ?: simulateProjectedSpendingForRange(
     521:                     periodStart = monthStart,
     522:                     periodEnd = TimePeriodUtils.getEndOfMonth(now),
     523:                     now = now,
     524:                     averageHistoricalDailySpending = averageHistoricalDailySpending,
     525:                     homeCurrency = homeCurrency
     526:                 )
     527:             TimeHorizon.QUARTER -> simulateProjectedSpendingForRange(
     528:                 periodStart = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfQuarter(now),
     529:                 periodEnd = TimePeriodUtils.getEndOfQuarter(now),
     530:                 now = now,
     531:                 averageHistoricalDailySpending = averageHistoricalDailySpending,
     532:                 homeCurrency = homeCurrency
     533:             )
     534:         }
     535:
     536:         val horizonDiscretionary = when (timeHorizon) {
     537:             TimeHorizon.WEEK -> monthlyDiscretionary / TimePeriodUtils.getDaysInMonth(now) * 7.0
     538:             TimeHorizon.MONTH -> monthlyDiscretionary
     539:             TimeHorizon.QUARTER -> monthlyDiscretionary * countCalendarMonthsInRange(
     540:                 TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfQuarter(now),
     541:                 TimePeriodUtils.getEndOfQuarter(now) - 1
     542:             )
     543:         }

     545:         val remaining = horizonDiscretionary -
     546:             (projectedHorizonSpending * simulationConfig.projectedSpendingRiskBufferRatio)
     547:
     548:         return if (remaining > 0.0) remaining * simulationConfig.safeToSaveRatio else 0.0
     549:     }

     551:     private suspend fun computeDynamicCap(timeHorizon: TimeHorizon, homeCurrency: String): Double {
     552:         // AIML-30: Use SpendingThresholdCalculator for adaptive caps based on user's
     553:         // actual spending distribution (P90 percentile) instead of hardcoded currencyless values.
     554:         val p90 = spendingThresholdCalculator.getThreshold()
     555:         return when (timeHorizon) {
     556:             TimeHorizon.WEEK -> (p90 * 0.15).coerceAtLeast(10.0)   // ~15% of P90 single-txn cap
     557:             TimeHorizon.MONTH -> (p90 * 0.40).coerceAtLeast(25.0)  // ~40% of P90
     558:             TimeHorizon.QUARTER -> (p90 * 1.00).coerceAtLeast(75.0) // ~100% of P90
     559:         }
     560:     }
     561:
     562:     private suspend fun calculateWeightedSafeAmount(
     563:         budgetSurplus: Double,
     564:         spendingPace: Double,
     565:         monteCarloResult: Double,
     566:         timeHorizon: TimeHorizon,
     567:         homeCurrency: String
     568:     ): Double {
     569:         // Weighted combination adjusted by time horizon
     570:         // AIML-30: Use SpendingThresholdCalculator for adaptive caps instead of hardcoded values.
     571:         val cap = computeDynamicCap(timeHorizon, homeCurrency)
     572:         val (budgetWeight, paceWeight, monteCarloWeight) = when (timeHorizon) {
     573:             TimeHorizon.WEEK -> Triple(0.30, 0.45, 0.25)
     574:             TimeHorizon.MONTH -> Triple(0.40, 0.30, 0.30)
     575:             TimeHorizon.QUARTER -> Triple(0.35, 0.20, 0.45)
     576:         }
     577:
     578:         val weighted =
     579:             budgetSurplus * budgetWeight +
     580:             spendingPace * paceWeight +
     581:             monteCarloResult * monteCarloWeight
     582:
     583:         return minOf(weighted, cap).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
     584:     }
     585:
     586:     private fun calculateConfidence(
     587:         budgetSurplus: Double,
     588:         spendingPace: Double,
     589:         monteCarloResult: Double
     590:     ): Double {
     591:         // Higher confidence if multiple sources agree
     592:         val sources = listOf(budgetSurplus, spendingPace, monteCarloResult).count { it > 10.0 }
     593:         return when (sources) {
     594:             3 -> 0.95
     595:             2 -> 0.80
     596:             1 -> 0.60
     597:             else -> 0.40
     598:         }
     599:     }

     601:     private fun generateImpactMessage(
     602:         amount: Double,
     603:         goal: SavingsGoal,
     604:         timeHorizon: TimeHorizon,
     605:         homeCurrency: String
     606:     ): String {
     607:         val remaining = goal.targetAmount - goal.currentAmount
     608:         if (remaining <= 0) {
     609:             return UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_IMPACT_GOAL_ALREADY_REACHED).asFallbackString()
     610:         }
     611:
     612:         val horizonDays = when (timeHorizon) {
     613:             TimeHorizon.WEEK -> 7.0
     614:             TimeHorizon.MONTH -> 30.0
     615:             TimeHorizon.QUARTER -> 90.0
     616:         }
     617:         val daysToGoal = if (amount > 0) {
     618:             kotlin.math.ceil((remaining / amount) * horizonDays).toInt()
     619:         } else {
     620:             Int.MAX_VALUE
     621:         }
     622:
     623:         return when {
     624:             daysToGoal <= 30 -> UiText.fromKey(
     625:                 DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_IMPACT_REACH_IN_DAYS_FORMAT,
     626:                 daysToGoal
     627:             ).asFallbackString()
     628:
     629:             daysToGoal <= 90 -> UiText.fromKey(
     630:                 DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_IMPACT_ON_TRACK_MONTHS_FORMAT,
     631:                 daysToGoal / 30
     632:             ).asFallbackString()
     633:
     634:             else -> UiText.fromKey(
     635:                 DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_IMPACT_STEADY_PROGRESS_FORMAT,
     636:                 UiTextArg.Money(goal.targetAmount, currency = homeCurrency, currencyAssumption = "ASSUMED_HOME_CURRENCY", showCents = false)
     637:             ).asFallbackString()
     638:         }
     639:     }
     640:
     641:     private fun UiText.asFallbackString(): String {
     642:         return when (this) {
     643:             is UiText.DynamicString -> value
     644:             is UiText.MessageKey -> if (args.isEmpty()) key else "$key ${args.joinToString(", ")}"
     645:             is UiText.PluralResource -> "plural:$resId($quantity)"
     646:             is UiText.StringResource -> "res:$resId"
     647:         }
     648:     }

     650:     private fun determinePrimarySource(
     651:         budgetSurplus: Double,
     652:         spendingPace: Double,
     653:         monteCarloResult: Double
     654:     ): RecommendationSource {
     655:         return when {
     656:             budgetSurplus > spendingPace && budgetSurplus > monteCarloResult -> RecommendationSource.BUDGET_SURPLUS
     657:             spendingPace > budgetSurplus && spendingPace > monteCarloResult -> RecommendationSource.SPENDING_PACE
     658:             else -> RecommendationSource.MONTE_CARLO
     659:         }

     662:     private fun isDiscretionaryCategory(
     663:         categoryId: Long?,
     664:         categoriesById: Map<Long, Category>
     665:     ): Boolean {
     666:         val essentialCategories = setOf(
     667:             "groceries", "rent", "utilities", "transport",
     668:             "insurance", "healthcare", "bills", "mortgage", "education", "loan"
     669:         )
     670:
     671:         val categoryName = categoryId
     672:             ?.let { categoriesById[it]?.name }
     673:             ?.trim()
     674:             ?.lowercase()
     675:
     676:         // AIML-31: Uncategorized transactions are treated as "unknown" (not
     677:         // discretionary) so they don't inflate the discretionary spending pool
     678:         // and distort savings recommendations.
     679:         if (categoryName == null) return false
     680:         return categoryName !in essentialCategories
     681:     }

     714:         now: Long,
     715:         averageHistoricalDailySpending: Double,
     716:         homeCurrency: String
     717:     ): Double {
     718:         return simulateProjectedSpendingForRange(
     719:             periodStart = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfWeek(now),

     726:
     727:     private suspend fun simulateProjectedSpendingForRange(
     728:         periodStart: Long,
     729:         periodEnd: Long,
     730:         now: Long,
     731:         averageHistoricalDailySpending: Double,
     732:         homeCurrency: String
     733:     ): Double {
     734:         val rawPurchases = expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(periodStart, now)
     735:         val purchasesNormalized = analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(rawPurchases, homeCurrency)
     736:         purchasesNormalized.requireCompleteMoneyInput(homeCurrency)
     737:         val purchases = purchasesNormalized.includedExpenses
     738:             .filter { it.transactionType == DomainTransactionType.PURCHASE && !it.isNotMine }
     739:         // SAFE: data normalized via AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer at line 536
     740:         val spentToDate = purchasesNormalized.completeMoneyAggregateForRows(purchases, homeCurrency).displayAmount
     741:         val remainingDays = ((periodEnd - now).coerceAtLeast(0L)).toDouble() / DAY_IN_MILLIS.toDouble()
     742:         return spentToDate + (averageHistoricalDailySpending * remainingDays)
     743:     }
     744:
     745:     private fun countCalendarMonthsInRange(startInclusive: Long, endInclusive: Long): Int {
     746:         if (endInclusive < startInclusive) return 0
     747:
     748:         val startYear = TimePeriodUtils.getYear(startInclusive)
     749:         val startMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getMonth(startInclusive)
     750:         val endYear = TimePeriodUtils.getYear(endInclusive)
     751:         val endMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getMonth(endInclusive)
     752:
     753:         return ((endYear - startYear) * 12 + (endMonth - startMonth) + 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
     754:     }

     756:     enum class TimeHorizon {
     757:         WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER
     758:     }

     170:         homeCurrency: String

     173:             as? SmartSavingsComputationResult.Available)
     174:             ?.recommendations

     177:     suspend fun calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(
     178:         goals: List<SavingsGoal>,
     179:         timeHorizon: TimeHorizon = TimeHorizon.MONTH,
     180:         homeCurrency: String
     181:     ): SmartSavingsComputationResult {
     182:         val targetCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
     183:             ?: return SmartSavingsComputationResult.Unavailable(
     184:                 reasonCode = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_TARGET_CURRENCY.name,
     185:                 metadata = SmartSavingsOutcomeMetadata(
     186:                     currency = homeCurrency,
     187:                     conversionQuality = ConversionQuality.UNAVAILABLE
     188:                 )
     189:             )
     190:         val incompleteGoals = goals.filter { goal ->
     191:             (goal.targetAmount - goal.currentAmount) > 0.0 &&
     192:                 CurrencyCode.parse(goal.currency) == targetCurrency
     193:         }
     194:
     195:         if (incompleteGoals.isEmpty()) {
     196:             return SmartSavingsComputationResult.NoRecommendation
     197:         }
     198:
     199:         val portfolioRecommendation = try {
     200:             calculatePortfolioSafeToSaveAmount(
     201:                 sampleGoal = incompleteGoals.first(),
     202:                 timeHorizon = timeHorizon,
     203:                 homeCurrency = homeCurrency
     204:             )
     205:         } catch (error: CancellationException) {
     206:             throw error
     207:         } catch (error: MoneyDisplayUnavailableException) {
     208:             return SmartSavingsComputationResult.Unavailable(
     209:                 reasonCode = error.reasonCode.name,
     210:                 metadata = SmartSavingsOutcomeMetadata(
     211:                     currency = homeCurrency,
     212:                     conversionQuality = ConversionQuality.UNAVAILABLE
     213:                 )
     214:             )
     215:         } catch (_: Exception) {
     216:             return SmartSavingsComputationResult.Unavailable(
     217:                 reasonCode = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE.name,
     218:                 metadata = SmartSavingsOutcomeMetadata(
     219:                     currency = homeCurrency,
     220:                     conversionQuality = ConversionQuality.UNAVAILABLE
     221:                 )
     222:             )
     223:         }
     224:
     225:         if (portfolioRecommendation.safeAmount <= 0.0) {
     226:             return SmartSavingsComputationResult.NoRecommendation
     227:         }
     228:
     229:         val allocations = allocateAcrossGoals(incompleteGoals, portfolioRecommendation.safeAmount)
     230:         val recommendations = incompleteGoals.mapIndexedNotNull { index, goal ->
     231:             val allocatedAmount = allocations.getOrElse(index) { 0.0 }
     232:             if (allocatedAmount <= 0.0) {
     233:                 null
     234:             } else {
     235:                 GoalSavingsRecommendation(
     236:                     goal = goal,
     237:                     recommendation = portfolioRecommendation.copy(
     238:                         safeAmount = allocatedAmount,
     239:                         impact = generateImpactMessage(allocatedAmount, goal, timeHorizon, homeCurrency)
     240:                     )
     241:                 )
     242:             }
     243:         }
     244:
     245:         return if (recommendations.isEmpty()) {
     246:             SmartSavingsComputationResult.NoRecommendation
     247:         } else {
     248:             SmartSavingsComputationResult.Available(
     249:                 recommendations = recommendations,
     250:                 metadata = SmartSavingsOutcomeMetadata(
     251:                     currency = homeCurrency,
     252:                     conversionQuality = ConversionQuality.COMPLETE,
     253:                     requestedRateBasis = RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE
     254:                 )
     255:             )
     256:         }
     257:     }

     259:     private fun calculateBudgetSurplus(budgetStatuses: List<BudgetStatus>): Double {
     260:         val scopedStatuses = budgetStatuses
     261:             .let { allStatuses ->
     262:                 val overallStatuses = allStatuses.filter { it.budget.categoryId == null }
     263:                 if (overallStatuses.isNotEmpty()) overallStatuses else allStatuses
     264:             }
     265:             .filter { it.remainingAmount > 0.0 }
     266:
     267:         var totalSurplus = 0.0
     268:         for (status in scopedStatuses) {
     269:             // Only count 50% of surplus to be conservative
     270:             totalSurplus += status.remainingAmount * 0.5
     271:         }
     272:         return totalSurplus
     273:     }
