     253:     private suspend fun calculatePortfolioSafeToSaveAmount(
     254:         sampleGoal: SavingsGoal,
     255:         timeHorizon: TimeHorizon,
     256:         homeCurrency: String,
     257:         quality: SavingsDecisionQuality
     258:     ): SavingsRecommendation {
     259:         val now = timeProvider.now()
     260:         val budgetStatuses = budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses().first()
     261:         if (budgetStatuses.any { it.isPartial || !it.percentKnown ||
     262:                 it.conversionWarning != null ||
     263:                 CurrencyCode.parse(it.currency) != CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency) ||
     264:                 CurrencyCode.parse(it.budget.currency) != CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency) }) {
     265:             quality.fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE)
     266:         }
     267:         if (budgetStatuses.any { !it.remainingAmount.isFinite() }) quality.fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_AMOUNT)
     268:
     269:         val budgetSurplus = calculateBudgetSurplus(budgetStatuses)
     270:         val spendingPace = analyzeSpendingPace(timeHorizon, homeCurrency, quality)
     271:         val monteCarloResult = runMonteCarloSimulation(sampleGoal, now, timeHorizon, homeCurrency, quality)
     272:         val safeAmount = calculateWeightedSafeAmount(
     273:             budgetSurplus = budgetSurplus,
     274:             spendingPace = spendingPace,
     275:             monteCarloResult = monteCarloResult,
     276:             timeHorizon = timeHorizon,
     277:             homeCurrency = homeCurrency
     278:         )
     279:
     280:         if (!safeAmount.isFinite()) quality.fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_AMOUNT)
     281:         return SavingsRecommendation(
     282:             safeAmount = safeAmount,
     283:             confidence = calculateConfidence(budgetSurplus, spendingPace, monteCarloResult),
     284:             impact = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_PORTFOLIO_RECOMMENDATION_READY).asFallbackString(),
     285:             source = determinePrimarySource(budgetSurplus, spendingPace, monteCarloResult),
     286:             currency = homeCurrency
     287:         )
     288:     }

     360:     private suspend fun analyzeSpendingPace(timeHorizon: TimeHorizon, homeCurrency: String, quality: SavingsDecisionQuality): Double {
     361:         val now = timeProvider.now()
     362:         val dayOfMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getDayOfMonth(now).coerceAtLeast(1)
     363:         val daysInMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getDaysInMonth(now)
     364:
     365:         // Get current month's spending (normalized to home currency)
     366:         val monthStart = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfMonth(now)
     367:
     368:         val rawExpenses = expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(monthStart, now)
     369:         val normalized = analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(rawExpenses, homeCurrency)
     370:         quality.requireComplete(SavingsInputStage.CURRENT_SPENDING, normalized)
     371:         val expenses = normalized.includedExpenses
     372:         // SAFE: data normalized via AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer at line 231
     373:         val totalSpent = expenses
     374:             .filter { it.transactionType == DomainTransactionType.PURCHASE && !it.isNotMine }
     375:             .let { purchases ->
     376:                 normalized.completeMoneyAggregateForRows(purchases, homeCurrency).displayAmount
     377:             }
     378:
     379:         // Calculate days elapsed and month length
     380:
     381:         // If spending slower than average pace, suggest saving the difference
     382:         val averageDailySpending = totalSpent / dayOfMonth
     383:         val projectedMonthTotal = averageDailySpending * daysInMonth
     384:
     385:         // Get typical monthly spending from history
     386:         val historyDays = when (timeHorizon) {
     387:             TimeHorizon.WEEK -> 28L
     388:             TimeHorizon.MONTH -> 90L
     389:             TimeHorizon.QUARTER -> 365L
     390:         }
     391:         val horizonMonths = when (timeHorizon) {
     392:             TimeHorizon.WEEK -> 0.25
     393:             TimeHorizon.MONTH -> 1.0
     394:             TimeHorizon.QUARTER -> 3.0
     395:         }
     396:
     397:         val historyStart = now - (historyDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
     398:         val rawHistoryExpenses = expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(historyStart, now)
     399:         val historyNormalized = analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(rawHistoryExpenses, homeCurrency)
     400:         quality.requireComplete(SavingsInputStage.PACE_HISTORY, historyNormalized)
     401:         val historyExpenses = historyNormalized.includedExpenses
     402:             .filter { it.transactionType == DomainTransactionType.PURCHASE && !it.isNotMine }
     403:
     404:         // SAFE: data normalized via AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer at line 257
     405:         val totalHistorySpending = historyNormalized.completeMoneyAggregateForRows(historyExpenses, homeCurrency).displayAmount
     406:         val monthlyBaselineSpending = if (historyDays > 0) {
     407:             totalHistorySpending / historyDays.toDouble() * 30.0
     408:         } else {
     409:             0.0
     410:         }
     411:         val horizonBaselineSpending = monthlyBaselineSpending * horizonMonths
     412:         val projectedHorizonTotal = projectedMonthTotal * horizonMonths
     413:
     414:         // If projected spending is less than average, we can save the difference
     415:         return if (projectedHorizonTotal < horizonBaselineSpending) {
     416:             (horizonBaselineSpending - projectedHorizonTotal) * 0.3 // Conservative 30%
     417:         } else {
     418:             0.0
     419:         }
     420:     }

     422:     private suspend fun runMonteCarloSimulation(
     423:         _goal: SavingsGoal,
     424:         now: Long,
     425:         timeHorizon: TimeHorizon,
     426:         homeCurrency: String,
     427:         quality: SavingsDecisionQuality
     428:     ): Double {
     429:         val simulationConfig = getSimulationConfig(timeHorizon)
     430:         val monthStart = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfMonth(now)
     431:         val rawMonthExpenses = expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(monthStart, now)
     432:         val monthNormalized = analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(rawMonthExpenses, homeCurrency)
     433:         quality.requireComplete(SavingsInputStage.FORECAST_CURRENT, monthNormalized)
     434:         val monthPurchases = monthNormalized.includedExpenses
     435:             .filter { it.transactionType == DomainTransactionType.PURCHASE && !it.isNotMine }
     436:         // SAFE: data normalized via AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer at line 287
     437:         val monthSpentToDate = monthNormalized.completeMoneyAggregateForRows(monthPurchases, homeCurrency).displayAmount
     438:
     439:         val lookbackStart = now - (simulationConfig.lookbackDays * DAY_IN_MILLIS)
     440:         val categoriesById = categoryRepository.getAll().associateBy { it.id }
     441:         val rawHistoricalPurchases = expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(lookbackStart, now)
     442:         val historicalNormalized = analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(rawHistoricalPurchases, homeCurrency)
     443:         quality.requireComplete(SavingsInputStage.FORECAST_HISTORY, historicalNormalized)
     444:         val historicalPurchases = historicalNormalized.includedExpenses
     445:             .filter { it.transactionType == DomainTransactionType.PURCHASE && !it.isNotMine }
     446:         // SAFE: data normalized via AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer at line 295
     447:         val discretionaryHistoricalTotal = historicalPurchases
     448:             .filter {
     449:                 isDiscretionaryCategory(it.categoryId, categoriesById)
     450:             }
     451:             .let { discretionary ->
     452:                 historicalNormalized.completeMoneyAggregateForRows(discretionary, homeCurrency).displayAmount
     453:             }
     454:         val endOfLastCompleteMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfMonth(now) - 1L
     455:         val lookbackMonthCount = countCalendarMonthsInRange(
     456:             startInclusive = lookbackStart,
     457:             endInclusive = endOfLastCompleteMonth
     458:         )
     459:         val monthlyDiscretionary = if (lookbackMonthCount > 0) {
     460:             discretionaryHistoricalTotal / lookbackMonthCount.toDouble()
     461:         } else {
     462:             simulationConfig.fallbackMonthlyDiscretionary
     463:         }
     464:
     465:         // SAFE: data normalized via AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer at line 295
     466:         val averageHistoricalDailySpending = if (historicalPurchases.isNotEmpty()) {
     467:             historicalNormalized.completeMoneyAggregateForRows(historicalPurchases, homeCurrency).displayAmount / simulationConfig.lookbackDays.toDouble()
     468:         } else {
     469:             0.0
     470:         }
     471:
     472:         // AI-4: Calculate known upcoming obligations from CashFlowCalculator using
     473:         // occurrence-driven recurring rules + planned expenses (deduplicated).
     474:         val daysRemainingInMonth = TimePeriodUtils.daysBetween(now, TimePeriodUtils.getEndOfMonth(now))
     475:         val daysRemaining = daysRemainingInMonth.coerceAtLeast(1)
     476:         val upcomingPatterns = cashFlowCalculator.getUpcomingBills(daysAhead = daysRemaining)
     477:         if (upcomingPatterns.any { CurrencyCode.parse(it.currency) != CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency) }) {
     478:             throw MoneyDisplayUnavailableException(
     479:                 com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE
     480:             )
     481:         }
     482:         val knownUpcoming = MoneyAggregateBuilder.fromHomeCurrencyAmounts(
     483:             upcomingPatterns.map { it.averageAmount }, homeCurrency
     484:         ).displayAmount
     485:         // FCST-4: Compute an estimated weekly recurring amount from the upcoming patterns
     486:         // so the Monte Carlo simulator can subtract recurring spend from its stochastic
     487:         // sampling and avoid double-counting with knownUpcoming.
     488:         val estimatedWeeklyRecurring = if (daysRemaining > 0) {
     489:             knownUpcoming / (daysRemaining / 7.0)
     490:         } else 0.0
     491:         val monthlyResult = monteCarloSimulator.simulate(
     492:             spentToDate = monthSpentToDate,
     493:             knownUpcoming = knownUpcoming,
     494:             budgetAmount = null, // No budget constraint
     495:             displayCurrency = homeCurrency,
     496:             estimatedWeeklyRecurring = estimatedWeeklyRecurring
     497:         )
     498:         quality.requireForecast(monthlyResult)
     499:
     500:         val projectedHorizonSpending = when (timeHorizon) {
     501:             TimeHorizon.WEEK -> simulateWeeklyProjectedSpending(now, averageHistoricalDailySpending, homeCurrency, quality)
     502:             TimeHorizon.MONTH -> monthlyResult?.percentile50
     503:                 ?: simulateProjectedSpendingForRange(
     504:                     periodStart = monthStart,
     505:                     periodEnd = TimePeriodUtils.getEndOfMonth(now),
     506:                     now = now,
     507:                     averageHistoricalDailySpending = averageHistoricalDailySpending,
     508:                     homeCurrency = homeCurrency,
     509:                     quality = quality
     510:                 )
     511:             TimeHorizon.QUARTER -> simulateProjectedSpendingForRange(
     512:                 periodStart = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfQuarter(now),
     513:                 periodEnd = TimePeriodUtils.getEndOfQuarter(now),
     514:                 now = now,
     515:                 averageHistoricalDailySpending = averageHistoricalDailySpending,
     516:                 homeCurrency = homeCurrency,
     517:                 quality = quality
     518:             )
     519:         }
     520:
     521:         val horizonDiscretionary = when (timeHorizon) {
     522:             TimeHorizon.WEEK -> monthlyDiscretionary / TimePeriodUtils.getDaysInMonth(now) * 7.0
     523:             TimeHorizon.MONTH -> monthlyDiscretionary
     524:             TimeHorizon.QUARTER -> monthlyDiscretionary * countCalendarMonthsInRange(
     525:                 TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfQuarter(now),
     526:                 TimePeriodUtils.getEndOfQuarter(now) - 1
     527:             )
     528:         }
     529:
     530:         val remaining = horizonDiscretionary -
     531:             (projectedHorizonSpending * simulationConfig.projectedSpendingRiskBufferRatio)
     532:
     533:         return if (remaining > 0.0) remaining * simulationConfig.safeToSaveRatio else 0.0
     534:     }

     714:     private suspend fun simulateProjectedSpendingForRange(
     715:         periodStart: Long,
     716:         periodEnd: Long,
     717:         now: Long,
     718:         averageHistoricalDailySpending: Double,
     719:         homeCurrency: String,
     720:         quality: SavingsDecisionQuality
     721:     ): Double {
     722:         val rawPurchases = expenseRepository.getExpenseSnapshotsBetween(periodStart, now)
     723:         val purchasesNormalized = analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(rawPurchases, homeCurrency)
     724:         quality.requireComplete(SavingsInputStage.RANGE_SPENDING, purchasesNormalized)
     725:         val purchases = purchasesNormalized.includedExpenses
     726:             .filter { it.transactionType == DomainTransactionType.PURCHASE && !it.isNotMine }
     727:         // SAFE: data normalized via AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer at line 536
     728:         val spentToDate = purchasesNormalized.completeMoneyAggregateForRows(purchases, homeCurrency).displayAmount
     729:         val remainingDays = ((periodEnd - now).coerceAtLeast(0L)).toDouble() / DAY_IN_MILLIS.toDouble()
     730:         return spentToDate + (averageHistoricalDailySpending * remainingDays)
     731:     }

     733:     private fun countCalendarMonthsInRange(startInclusive: Long, endInclusive: Long): Int {
     734:         if (endInclusive < startInclusive) return 0
     735:
     736:         val startYear = TimePeriodUtils.getYear(startInclusive)
     737:         val startMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getMonth(startInclusive)
     738:         val endYear = TimePeriodUtils.getYear(endInclusive)
     739:         val endMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getMonth(endInclusive)
     740:
     741:         return ((endYear - startYear) * 12 + (endMonth - startMonth) + 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
     742:     }

      39: /**
      40:  * Monthly Savings Sweep Use Case.
      41:  *
      42:  * Computes end-of-month savings sweep recommendations by analyzing:
      43:  * 1. Budget underspend across all categories
      44:  * 2. Monte Carlo risk buffer for spending uncertainty
      45:  * 3. Safe sweep amount = underspend - riskBuffer
      46:  * 4. Allocation across active savings goals based on urgency
      47:  *
      48:  * ## Formula
      49:  * ```
      50:  * safeSweep = max(0, underspend - riskBuffer)
      51:  * where:
      52:  * - underspend = overall remaining (if overall budget exists) OR sum of category remaining
      53:  * - riskBuffer = MC uncertainty buffer (p75 - p50)
      54:  * ```
      55:  */
      56: @Singleton
      57: class MonthlySavingsSweepUseCase @Inject constructor(
      58:     private val budgetRepository: BudgetRepository,
      59:     private val savingsGoalRepository: SavingsGoalRepository,
      60:     private val expenseRepository: ExpenseRepository,
      61:     private val recurringExpenseRepository: RecurringExpenseRepository,
      62:     private val plannedExpenseRepository: PlannedExpenseRepository,
      63:     private val monteCarloSimulator: MonteCarloSpendingSimulator,
      64:     private val timeProvider: TimeProvider,
      65:     private val analyticsCurrencyNormalizer: AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer,
      66:     private val currencySettingsRepository: CurrencySettingsRepository,
      67:     private val currencyConverter: CurrencyConverter,
      68:     private val recurringOccurrenceDao: RecurringOccurrenceDao
      69: ) {
      70:     companion object {
      71:         /** Minimum safe sweep amount to show recommendation (in home currency) */
      72:         const val MIN_SWEEP_AMOUNT = 5.0
      73:
      74:         /** Days before month-end to start showing sweep recommendations */
      75:         const val DAYS_BEFORE_MONTH_END = 5
      76:
      77:         /** Confidence threshold for showing recommendations */
      78:         const val MIN_CONFIDENCE = 0.4
      79:
      80:         /** Maximum single allocation as percentage of safe sweep */
      81:         const val MAX_SINGLE_ALLOCATION_PERCENT = 0.8
      82:     }
      83:
      84:     /**
      85:      * Compute end-of-month savings sweep recommendation.

      42:  * Computes end-of-month savings sweep recommendations by analyzing:
      43:  * 1. Budget underspend across all categories

     252:     /**
     253:      * Check if we're within the sweep recommendation window.
     254:      * Returns true during the last [DAYS_BEFORE_MONTH_END] days of the month.
     255:      */
     256:     private fun isWithinSweepWindow(today: LocalDate): Boolean {
     257:         val daysInMonth = today.lengthOfMonth()
     258:         val dayOfMonth = today.dayOfMonth
     259:         return dayOfMonth >= (daysInMonth - DAYS_BEFORE_MONTH_END + 1)
     260:     }
     261:
     262:     /**
     263:      * Calculate total underspend across all budget categories.
     264:      * Only counts remaining amounts (not overspent budgets).
     265:      *
     266:      * @return Triple of (underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent)
     267:      */
     268:     private fun calculateUnderspend(budgetStatuses: List<BudgetStatus>): Triple<Double, Double, Double> {
     269:         val overallBudget = budgetStatuses.firstOrNull { it.budget.categoryId == null }
     270:         val selectedStatuses = if (overallBudget != null) {
     271:             listOf(overallBudget)
     272:         } else {
     273:             budgetStatuses.filter { it.budget.categoryId != null }
     274:         }
     275:
     276:         val underspend = selectedStatuses.sumOf { status ->
     277:             status.remainingAmount.coerceAtLeast(0.0)
     278:         }
     279:         // T4C oracle: the sweep risk baseline uses the budgeted amount.
     280:         // effectiveLimit is a BudgetMonitor display concept and is 0 in
     281:         // legacy status snapshots, which would zero the budget-based
     282:         // fallback risk buffer.
     283:         val totalBudgeted = selectedStatuses.sumOf { it.budget.amount }
     284:         val totalSpent = selectedStatuses.sumOf { it.spentAmount }
     285:
     286:         return Triple(underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent)
     287:     }

     458:         val endOfLastCompleteMonth = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfMonth(now) - 1L

     463:         val monthlyDiscretionary = if (lookbackMonthCount > 0) {

    package com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.savings
    
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.AnalyticsNormalizationResult
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.requireCompleteMoneyInput
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.ConversionQuality
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.CurrencyCode
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyDisplayUnavailableException
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.RateBasis
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.forecasting.MonteCarloResult
    
    /** Counts describe normalization observations; overlapping windows are not unique transactions. */
    data class SmartSavingsOutcomeMetadata(
        val currency: String? = null,
        val conversionQuality: ConversionQuality = ConversionQuality.COMPLETE,
        val requestedRateBasis: RateBasis = RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
        /** Multiple stages can use different legitimate policies; do not collapse them. */
        val requestedRateBases: Set<RateBasis> = emptySet(),
        val totalInputCount: Int = 0,
        val includedInputCount: Int = 0,
        val excludedInputCount: Int = 0,
        val warningCodes: List<String> = emptyList(),
        val latestRateTimestamp: Long? = null,
        val settingsRateTimestamp: Long? = null,
        val actualRateBases: Set<RateBasis> = emptySet(),
        val inputs: List<SavingsInputQuality> = emptyList()
    )
    
    data class SavingsInputQuality(
        val stage: SavingsInputStage,
        val totalInputCount: Int,
        val includedInputCount: Int,
        val excludedInputCount: Int,
        val warningCodes: List<String>,
        val requestedRateBasis: RateBasis,
        val actualRateBasis: RateBasis,
        val latestRateTimestamp: Long?
    )
    
    enum class SavingsInputStage {
        CURRENT_SPENDING, PACE_HISTORY, FORECAST_CURRENT, FORECAST_HISTORY,
        RANGE_SPENDING, RECURRING_UPCOMING, PLANNED_UPCOMING, SIMULATOR_HISTORY
    }
    
    /** Request-local collector: no financial amounts, payloads or exception messages. */
    internal class SavingsDecisionQuality(var currency: String) {
        private val inputs = mutableListOf<SavingsInputQuality>()
        private val warnings = linkedSetOf<String>()
        var settingsRateTimestamp: Long? = null
    
        fun requireComplete(stage: SavingsInputStage, input: AnalyticsNormalizationResult) {
            val codes = (input.warnings.map { it.type.name } +
                input.normalizedExpenses.mapNotNull { it.qualityWarning?.name }).distinct()
            inputs += SavingsInputQuality(
                stage, input.totalInputCount, input.normalizedExpenses.size, input.excludedCount,
                codes, RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                if (input.normalizedExpenses.all { CurrencyCode.parse(it.originalCurrency) == CurrencyCode.parse(currency) })
                    RateBasis.IDENTITY else RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                input.latestRateTimestamp
            )
            try {
                input.requireCompleteMoneyInput(currency)
            } catch (error: MoneyDisplayUnavailableException) {
                warnings += error.reasonCode.name
                throw error
            }
        }
    
        fun recordUpcoming(stage: SavingsInputStage, count: Int, excluded: Int, codes: List<String>, identity: Boolean) {
            inputs += SavingsInputQuality(
                stage, count, count - excluded, excluded, codes.distinct(),
                RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE, if (identity) RateBasis.IDENTITY else RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE, null
            )
        }
    
        fun requireForecast(result: MonteCarloResult?) {
            // Null is the simulator's valid no-data contract; callers retain their conservative fallback.
            if (result == null) return
            result.metadata.historicalMoneyQuality?.let { quality ->
                inputs += SavingsInputQuality(
                    SavingsInputStage.SIMULATOR_HISTORY, quality.totalInputCount, quality.includedInputCount,
                    quality.excludedInputCount, quality.warnings.map { it.type.name }.distinct(),
                    quality.requestedRateBasis, quality.actualRateBasis, quality.latestRateTimestamp
                )
                if (quality.quality != ConversionQuality.COMPLETE ||
                    quality.excludedInputCount > 0 || quality.warnings.isNotEmpty()) {
                    fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE)
                }
            }
            if (CurrencyCode.parse(result.displayCurrency) != CurrencyCode.parse(currency)) {
                fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE)
            }
            if (listOf(result.percentile50, result.percentile75, result.confidence.score).any { !it.isFinite() } ||
                result.percentile50 < 0.0 || result.percentile75 < result.percentile50 ||
                result.confidence.score !in 0.0..1.0) {
                fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_AMOUNT)
            }
        }
    
        fun fail(reason: MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode): Nothing {
            warnings += reason.name
            throw MoneyDisplayUnavailableException(reason)
        }
    
        fun snapshot(unavailable: Boolean = false) = SmartSavingsOutcomeMetadata(
            currency = CurrencyCode.parse(currency)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }?.code,
            conversionQuality = if (unavailable) ConversionQuality.UNAVAILABLE else ConversionQuality.COMPLETE,
            totalInputCount = inputs.sumOf { it.totalInputCount },
            includedInputCount = inputs.sumOf { it.includedInputCount },
            excludedInputCount = inputs.sumOf { it.excludedInputCount },
            warningCodes = (warnings + inputs.flatMap { it.warningCodes }).distinct(),
            latestRateTimestamp = inputs.mapNotNull { it.latestRateTimestamp }.maxOrNull(),
            settingsRateTimestamp = settingsRateTimestamp,
            requestedRateBases = inputs.map { it.requestedRateBasis }.toSet(),
            actualRateBases = inputs.map { it.actualRateBasis }.toSet(),
            inputs = inputs.toList()
        )
    }

        private lateinit var budgetRepository: BudgetRepository
        private lateinit var budgetCalculator: BudgetCalculator
        private lateinit var monteCarloSimulator: MonteCarloSpendingSimulator
        private lateinit var savingsGoalRepository: SavingsGoalRepository
        private lateinit var analyticsCurrencyNormalizer: AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer
        private lateinit var cashFlowCalculator: CashFlowCalculator
        private lateinit var spendingThresholdCalculator: SpendingThresholdCalculator
        private lateinit var engine: SmartSavingsEngine
    
        private val now = LocalDate.of(2026, 4, 15)
            .atStartOfDay(ZoneId.systemDefault())
            .toInstant()
            .toEpochMilli()
    
        @Before
        override fun setUp() {
            super.setUp()
            expenseRepository = mockk(relaxed = true)
            categoryRepository = mockk(relaxed = true)
            budgetRepository = mockk(relaxed = true)
            budgetCalculator = mockk(relaxed = true)
            monteCarloSimulator = mockk(relaxed = true)
            savingsGoalRepository = mockk(relaxed = true)
            analyticsCurrencyNormalizer = mockk(relaxed = true)
            coEvery { analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(any(), any()) } answers {
                val expenses = firstArg<List<com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.model.ExpenseSnapshot>>()
                val homeCurrency = secondArg<String>()
                com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.AnalyticsNormalizationResult(
                    homeCurrency = homeCurrency,
                    normalizedExpenses = expenses.map {
                        com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.NormalizedExpenseSnapshot(
                            snapshot = it,
                            originalCurrency = it.currency,
                            originalEffectiveAmount = it.effectiveAmount,
                            normalizedEffectiveAmount = it.effectiveAmount
                        )
                    },
                    includedExpenses = expenses,
                    warnings = emptyList(),
                    latestRateTimestamp = null,
                    totalInputCount = expenses.size
                )
            }
    
            io.mockk.every { timeProvider.now() } returns now
    
            cashFlowCalculator = mockk<CashFlowCalculator>(relaxed = true)
            spendingThresholdCalculator = mockk<SpendingThresholdCalculator>(relaxed = true)
            coEvery { spendingThresholdCalculator.getThreshold() } returns 500.0
    
            engine = SmartSavingsEngine(
                expenseRepository = expenseRepository,
                categoryRepository = categoryRepository,
                budgetRepository = budgetRepository,
                budgetCalculator = budgetCalculator,
                monteCarloSimulator = monteCarloSimulator,
                timeProvider = timeProvider,
                analyticsCurrencyNormalizer = analyticsCurrencyNormalizer,
                cashFlowCalculator = cashFlowCalculator,
                spendingThresholdCalculator = spendingThresholdCalculator
            )
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `cross currency goals are declined rather than relabeled`() = runTest {
            val goal = SavingsGoal(1L, "Trip", 1000.0, 0.0, null, GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, currency = "USD", createdAt = now)
            assertTrue(engine.calculatePortfolioRecommendations(listOf(goal), homeCurrency = "EUR").isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `excluded spending cannot create a savings recommendation`() = runTest {
            io.mockk.every { budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses() } returns flowOf(emptyList())
            coEvery { analyticsCurrencyNormalizer.normalizeSnapshots(any(), any()) } returns
                com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.AnalyticsNormalizationResult(
                    "EUR", emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(), null, totalInputCount = 2
                )
            val goal = SavingsGoal(1L, "Trip", 1000.0, 0.0, null, GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, createdAt = now)
            assertTrue(engine.calculatePortfolioRecommendations(listOf(goal), homeCurrency = "EUR").isEmpty())
        }
    
        @Test
        }
    
        private fun configureRepositoryWithGoals(initialGoals: List<SavingsGoal>) {
            goalsFlow = MutableStateFlow(initialGoals)
    
            every { savingsGoalRepository.observeSavingsGoals() } returns goalsFlow
    
            coEvery { savingsGoalRepository.createSavingsGoal(any()) } coAnswers {
                val incoming = invocation.args[0] as SavingsGoal
                val nextId = (goalsFlow.value.maxOfOrNull { it.id } ?: 0L) + 1L
                goalsFlow.value = goalsFlow.value + incoming.copy(id = nextId)
                nextId
            }
    
            coEvery { savingsGoalRepository.incrementSavingsGoalAmount(any(), any()) } coAnswers {
                val goalId = invocation.args[0] as Long
                val delta = invocation.args[1] as Double
                val exists = goalsFlow.value.any { it.id == goalId }
                if (exists) {
                    goalsFlow.value = goalsFlow.value.map { goal ->
                        if (goal.id == goalId) goal.copy(currentAmount = goal.currentAmount + delta) else goal
                    }
                }
                exists
            }
        }
    
        private fun createViewModel(): SavingsGoalsViewModel {
            val currencyRepo = mockk<CurrencySettingsRepository>(relaxed = true)
            every { currencyRepo.homeCurrency() } returns currencyFlow
            every { currencyRepo.lastRateUpdate() } returns rateFlow
            coEvery { currencyRepo.resolveHomeCurrency() } returns HomeCurrencyResolution.Resolved(CurrencyCode("EUR"))
            return SavingsGoalsViewModel(
                savingsGoalRepository = savingsGoalRepository,
                savingsContributionHistoryRepository = savingsContributionHistoryRepository,
                smartSavingsEngine = smartSavingsEngine,
                gamificationEngine = gamificationEngine,
                lifestyleSavingsPromptUseCase = lifestyleSavingsPromptUseCase,
                monthlySavingsSweepUseCase = monthlySavingsSweepUseCase,
                timeProvider = timeProvider,
                currencySettingsRepository = currencyRepo,
            ).also { viewModels += it }
        }
    
        private fun createGoal(
            id: Long,
            name: String,
            targetAmount: Double,
            currentAmount: Double
        ): SavingsGoal {
            return SavingsGoal(
                id = id,
                name = name,
                targetAmount = targetAmount,
                currentAmount = currentAmount,
                targetDate = null,
                protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING,
                createdAt = timeProvider.now(),
            )
        }
    }

    package com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.savings
    
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.AnalyticsNormalizationResult
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.analytics.requireCompleteMoneyInput
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.ConversionQuality
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.CurrencyCode
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyDisplayUnavailableException
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.RateBasis
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.forecasting.MonteCarloResult
    
    /** Counts describe normalization observations; overlapping windows are not unique transactions. */
    data class SmartSavingsOutcomeMetadata(
        val currency: String? = null,
        val conversionQuality: ConversionQuality = ConversionQuality.COMPLETE,
        val requestedRateBasis: RateBasis = RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
        /** Multiple stages can use different legitimate policies; do not collapse them. */
        val requestedRateBases: Set<RateBasis> = emptySet(),
        val totalInputCount: Int = 0,
        val includedInputCount: Int = 0,
        val excludedInputCount: Int = 0,
        val warningCodes: List<String> = emptyList(),
        val latestRateTimestamp: Long? = null,
        val settingsRateTimestamp: Long? = null,
        val actualRateBases: Set<RateBasis> = emptySet(),
        val inputs: List<SavingsInputQuality> = emptyList()
    )
    
    data class SavingsInputQuality(
        val stage: SavingsInputStage,
        val totalInputCount: Int,
        val includedInputCount: Int,
        val excludedInputCount: Int,
        val warningCodes: List<String>,
        val requestedRateBasis: RateBasis,
        val actualRateBasis: RateBasis,
        val latestRateTimestamp: Long?
    )
    
    enum class SavingsInputStage {
        CURRENT_SPENDING, PACE_HISTORY, FORECAST_CURRENT, FORECAST_HISTORY,
        RANGE_SPENDING, RECURRING_UPCOMING, PLANNED_UPCOMING, SIMULATOR_HISTORY
    }
    
    /** Request-local collector: no financial amounts, payloads or exception messages. */
    internal class SavingsDecisionQuality(var currency: String) {
        private val inputs = mutableListOf<SavingsInputQuality>()
        private val warnings = linkedSetOf<String>()
        var settingsRateTimestamp: Long? = null
    
        fun requireComplete(stage: SavingsInputStage, input: AnalyticsNormalizationResult) {
            val codes = (input.warnings.map { it.type.name } +
                input.normalizedExpenses.mapNotNull { it.qualityWarning?.name }).distinct()
            inputs += SavingsInputQuality(
                stage, input.totalInputCount, input.normalizedExpenses.size, input.excludedCount,
                codes, RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                if (input.normalizedExpenses.all { CurrencyCode.parse(it.originalCurrency) == CurrencyCode.parse(currency) })
                    RateBasis.IDENTITY else RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                input.latestRateTimestamp
            )
            try {
                input.requireCompleteMoneyInput(currency)
            } catch (error: MoneyDisplayUnavailableException) {
                warnings += error.reasonCode.name
                throw error
            }
        }
    
        fun recordUpcoming(stage: SavingsInputStage, count: Int, excluded: Int, codes: List<String>, identity: Boolean) {
            inputs += SavingsInputQuality(
                stage, count, count - excluded, excluded, codes.distinct(),
                RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE, if (identity) RateBasis.IDENTITY else RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE, null
            )
        }
    
        fun requireForecast(result: MonteCarloResult?) {
            // Null is the simulator's valid no-data contract; callers retain their conservative fallback.
            if (result == null) return
            result.metadata.historicalMoneyQuality?.let { quality ->
                inputs += SavingsInputQuality(
                    SavingsInputStage.SIMULATOR_HISTORY, quality.totalInputCount, quality.includedInputCount,
                    quality.excludedInputCount, quality.warnings.map { it.type.name }.distinct(),
                    quality.requestedRateBasis, quality.actualRateBasis, quality.latestRateTimestamp
                )
                if (quality.quality != ConversionQuality.COMPLETE ||
                    quality.excludedInputCount > 0 || quality.warnings.isNotEmpty()) {
                    fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE)
                }
            }
            if (CurrencyCode.parse(result.displayCurrency) != CurrencyCode.parse(currency)) {
                fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE)
            }
            if (listOf(result.percentile50, result.percentile75, result.confidence.score).any { !it.isFinite() } ||
                result.percentile50 < 0.0 || result.percentile75 < result.percentile50 ||
                result.confidence.score !in 0.0..1.0) {
                fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_AMOUNT)
            }
        }
    
        fun fail(reason: MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode): Nothing {
            warnings += reason.name
            throw MoneyDisplayUnavailableException(reason)
        }
    
        fun snapshot(unavailable: Boolean = false) = SmartSavingsOutcomeMetadata(
            currency = CurrencyCode.parse(currency)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }?.code,
            conversionQuality = if (unavailable) ConversionQuality.UNAVAILABLE else ConversionQuality.COMPLETE,
            totalInputCount = inputs.sumOf { it.totalInputCount },
            includedInputCount = inputs.sumOf { it.includedInputCount },
            excludedInputCount = inputs.sumOf { it.excludedInputCount },

    ---
    name: review-strict
    description: Strict review of the current uncommitted diff with architecture, privacy, and test checks. Use when the user asks for a strict review of current changes.
    ---
    
    # Review Strict
    
    Review the current uncommitted worktree diff. Extra plan/context comes from the invoking message.
    
    Delegate the review to the `reviewer-strict` agent.
    
    ## Instructions
    
    1. Inspect `git status`.
    2. Inspect `git diff`.
    3. Identify changed files.
    4. Read surrounding code and relevant call sites.
    5. Compare against the provided plan/context if any.
    6. Check architecture, privacy/security, tests, and regression risk.
    7. If the diff touches guard scripts, baselines, allowlists, or exceptions, verify none are weakened and cite `FINAL_CI_GUARD_ACCEPTANCE_GATE.md` FG-03/FG-06/FG-07/FG-23.
    8. Do not edit files.
    9. Report only concrete, evidence-backed issues.
    10. If no approved plan is available, say so and review against the diff and repository rules.
    
    ## Strict focus
    
    Always check carefully if the diff touches:
    
    - workers / WorkManager
    - privacy/security/permissions
    - diagnostics/logging persistence
    - Room entities/DAOs/migrations/schema
    - backup/restore/export/cloud AI
    - money/currency
    - transaction/receipt/recurring lifecycle
    - static architecture guards
    - cross-layer/cross-module changes
    
    ## Output format
    
    ```markdown
    VERDICT: PASS | FAIL
    
    Summary:
    - Changed scope: ...
    - Plan available: yes|no
    - Main risk areas checked: ...
    - Architecture docs/rules checked: ...
    
    Issues:
    - [ISSUE-1] [CRITICAL|MAJOR|MINOR] problem - `file` - why it matters - minimal fix
    
    Coverage:
    - Requirements met: yes|no|unknown
    - Testing adequate: yes|no
    - Regression risk: low|medium|high
    
    Questions:
    - ...
    
    Notes:
    - ...
    ```
    
    If there are no issues:
    
    ```markdown
    Issues:
    - None
    ```
    ---
    name: run-validation
    description: Run one serialized compile, test, lint, or guard profile through the durable validation runner and report its result.
    ---
    
    # Run Validation
    
    Use the `validation-runner` agent. It is the sole owner of live compilation,
    test, lint, connected-test, and guard execution.
    
    ## Rules
    
    1. Use only `scripts/validation-runner.ps1`; never invoke Gradle or guard
       scripts directly.
    2. Start one allowlisted profile and capture the run ID.
    3. Poll `Status`. Exit code 3 means RUNNING, not failure.
    4. Do not start concurrent validation.
    5. PASS requires both a PASS result and completion marker.
    6. Route failures to `ci-build-debugger`/coder; the runner never edits.
    7. Guard execution is verification-only; never alter baselines, allowlists,
       exceptions, or policy.
    8. Use heartbeat/output timestamps and byte counts to detect stalled output.
    9. Prefer named serial shards over the full suite for broad local evidence.
    10. Treat app-check and static-guards as distinct gates; do not skip either when required.
    
    ## Profiles
    
    `compile`, `assemble-debug`, `targeted-unit-test`, `unit-test-shard`,
    `trusted-tests`, `legacy-tests`, `unit-tests`, `migration-tests`, `lint`,
    `static-guards`, `registered-guard`, `app-check`, `connected-tests`,
    `runner-smoke`, `runner-stall-smoke`.
    
    ## Report
    
    ```markdown
    VALIDATION VERDICT: PASS|FAIL|RUNNING|INFRA_FAILURE|STALE_RESULT
    - run ID: ...
    - profile: ...
    - exit code: ...
    - result/log paths: ...
    - next action: ...
    ```

        private suspend fun computeSavingsSweepWidget(): DashboardWidget? {
            return try {
                val result = kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull(3000L) {
                    monthlySavingsSweepUseCase.computeSweepRecommendationResult()
                } ?: SavingsSweepComputationResult.Unavailable(
                    MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE.name
                )
                when (result) {
                    is SavingsSweepComputationResult.NoRecommendation -> null
                    is SavingsSweepComputationResult.Unavailable -> DashboardWidget.SavingsSweepUnavailable(
                        MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == result.reasonCode }?.name
                            ?: MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE.name,
                        result.metadata
                    )
                    is SavingsSweepComputationResult.Available -> {
                        val recommendation = result.recommendation
                        DashboardWidget.SavingsSweepPrompt(
                        sweepAmount = recommendation.safeSweepAmount,
                        underspend = recommendation.totalUnderspend,
                        riskBuffer = recommendation.riskBuffer,
                        goalAllocations = recommendation.goalAllocations.map { allocation ->
                            DashboardWidget.SweepGoalAllocation(
                                goalId = allocation.goalId,
                                goalName = allocation.goalName,
                                suggestedAmount = allocation.suggestedAllocation,
                                currentProgress = allocation.currentProgress,
                                targetAmount = allocation.targetAmount
                            )
                        },
                        confidence = recommendation.confidence,
                        daysUntilMonthEnd = TimePeriodUtils.daysBetween(recommendation.computedAt, recommendation.monthEnd)
                            .coerceAtLeast(0),
                        currency = recommendation.currency,
                        metadata = result.metadata
                    )
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Timber.w("SAVINGS_SWEEP_UNAVAILABLE class=%s", e.javaClass.simpleName)
                DashboardWidget.SavingsSweepUnavailable(

                )
            }
        }

        @Test
        fun `consistency - PeriodSummary monthSpent matches purchases effectiveAmount sum`() = runTest {
            val now = ts(2024, 5, 15)
            val monthStart = com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.util.TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfMonth(now)
            val purchases = listOf(
                createExpense(100.0, monthStart + 86400000),
                createExpense(200.0, monthStart + 172800000),
                createExpense(50.0, monthStart + 259200000, isSharedExpense = true, myShareAmount = 25.0),
            )
            val expectedMonthSpent = 100.0 + 200.0 + 25.0
    
            val processedData = createProcessedData(expenses = purchases.map { it.toDashboardExpense() }, monthSpent = expectedMonthSpent)
            val result = computeUseCase.compute(processedData)
    
            val periodSummary = result.allWidgets.filterIsInstance<DashboardWidget.PeriodSummary>().single()
            assertEquals("PeriodSummary monthSpent must match", expectedMonthSpent, periodSummary.monthSpent, 0.001)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `consistency - FinancialRunway committed and likely from SynthesisEngine`() = runTest {
            val now = ts(2024, 5, 15)
            val monthStart = com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.util.TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfMonth(now)
            val purchases = listOf(createExpense(100.0, monthStart + 86400000))
            val recurring = listOf(
                RecurringPattern(
                    merchantName = "Netflix",
                    averageAmount = 15.0,
                    currency = "EUR",
                    frequency = RecurrenceFrequency.MONTHLY,
                    periodVarianceDays = 0,
                    amountVariancePercent = 0.0,
                    nextExpectedDate = monthStart + 20 * 86400000L,
                    confidence = 0.95f,
                    previousDates = emptyList()
                )
            )
            val planned = listOf(
                PlannedExpense(id = 0, description = "Trip", amount = 500.0, date = monthStart + 25 * 86400000L, categoryId = null, isRecurring = false, priority = PlannedExpensePriority.MUST)
            )
            val budgetStatus = BudgetStatusSnapshot(
                budgetCategoryId = null,
                budgetAmount = 1000.0,
                categoryName = null,
                spentAmount = 100.0,
                remainingAmount = 900.0,
                percentUsed = 10.0,
                healthStatus = BudgetHealthStatus.ON_TRACK,
                periodStart = monthStart,
                periodEnd = monthStart + 30 * 86400000L
            )
    
            val processedData = createProcessedData(
                expenses = purchases.map { it.toDashboardExpense() },
                monthSpent = 100.0,
                budgetStatuses = listOf(budgetStatus),
                recurringPatterns = recurring,
                plannedExpenses = planned
            )
            val result = computeUseCase.compute(processedData)
    
            val runway = result.allWidgets.filterIsInstance<DashboardWidget.FinancialRunway>().singleOrNull()
            assertNotNull("Runway should be present when budget and data exist", runway)
            assertTrue("Runway committed+likely should be non-negative", runway!!.committedExpenses + runway.likelyExpenses >= 0)
        }

    Execute one approved batch only. The batch description comes from the invoking message. Codex skills have no argument passing: treat everything in the invoking message as the batch/request.

    1. Identify the exact batch to execute.
    2. Confirm an approved plan exists in the conversation or provided file path.
    3. If no approved plan exists, stop and ask the user for planning first (act as the orchestrator planning phase).
    4. Use the smallest safe workflow:
       - trivial low-risk edits: implement directly
       - normal work: implement + targeted tests
       - strict for workers/privacy/security/Room/lifecycle/static guards/cross-layer work
    5. Do not implement unrelated batches.
    6. Do not broaden scope.
    7. Require targeted tests for behavior changes.
    8. Require strict review (reviewer-strict agent) for risky batches.
    9. When a batch touches guard scripts, baselines, allowlists, or exceptions, verify against `FINAL_CI_GUARD_ACCEPTANCE_GATE.md` (path + FG-ID only) that nothing is weakened and fail-closed semantics (FG-03) are preserved.
    10. Stop on reviewer fail, test fail, privacy ambiguity, architecture ambiguity, schema surprises, or unexpected broad diff.
    
    ## Default batch loop
    
    ```text
    scout subagent if needed
    â†’ specialist-coder implements
    â†’ tester-runtime authors tests and/or tester-static assesses coverage
    â†’ reviewer-strict for risky batches
    â†’ validation-runner runs the narrowest applicable live profile
    ```

    For risky work:
    
    ```text
    scout
    â†’ relevant guardian (architecture-guardian, privacy-security-guardian, room-migration-guardian)

    â†’ tester-runtime authors tests + tester-static assesses coverage

    â†’ reviewer-strict
    ```

    data class SavingsStreak(
        val currentStreakDays: Int,
        val personalBestDays: Int,
        val lastSavingsDate: Long?,
        val monthlyContributions: Int,
        val totalContributedThisMonth: Double?,
        val totalContributedThisMonthResult: MoneyAggregateResult? = null,
        val isAvailable: Boolean = true
    )
    
    data class SavingsAchievement(
        val id: String,
        val title: UiText,
        val description: UiText,
        val icon: String, // Emoji or icon name
        val isUnlocked: Boolean,
        val unlockedAt: Long?,
        val progress: Double, // 0.0 to 1.0
        val requirement: UiText,
        val isAvailable: Boolean = true
    )
    
    @Singleton
    class SavingsGamificationEngine @Inject constructor(
        private val savingsGoalRepository: SavingsGoalRepository,
        private val contributionHistoryRepository: SavingsContributionHistoryRepository,
        private val timeProvider: TimeProvider,
        private val analyticsCurrencyNormalizer: AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer,
        private val currencySettingsRepository: CurrencySettingsRepository,
        private val currencyConverter: CurrencyConverter
    ) {
        companion object {
            // Achievement thresholds in home currency
            private const val CENTURY_SAVER_THRESHOLD = 100.0
            private const val GRAND_SAVER_THRESHOLD = 1000.0
            private const val LEVEL_UP_EVERY = 500.0
        }
        suspend fun calculateStreak(userId: String = "default"): SavingsStreak {
            val contributionMetrics = analyzeContributionHistory()
    
            return SavingsStreak(
                currentStreakDays = contributionMetrics.currentStreakDays,
                personalBestDays = contributionMetrics.personalBestDays,
                lastSavingsDate = contributionMetrics.lastSavingsDate,
                monthlyContributions = contributionMetrics.monthlyContributions,
                totalContributedThisMonth = contributionMetrics.totalContributedThisMonth,
                totalContributedThisMonthResult = contributionMetrics.totalContributedThisMonthResult,
                isAvailable = contributionMetrics.historyAvailable
            )
        }
    
        suspend fun getAchievements(userId: String = "default", homeCurrency: String): List<SavingsAchievement> {
            val goals = savingsGoalRepository.observeSavingsGoals().first()
            val contributionMetrics = analyzeContributionHistory(homeCurrency, goals)
            val sortedGoals = goals.sortedBy { it.createdAt }
            val firstGoalUnlockedAt = sortedGoals.firstOrNull()?.createdAt
            val totalSavedAggregate = aggregateGoalBalances(goals, homeCurrency)
            val totalSaved = totalSavedAggregate.displayAmountOrNull()
                .takeIf { contributionMetrics.historyAvailable }
            val totalSavedThresholds = resolveTotalSavedThresholdUnlocks(
                goals = goals,
                normalizedContributions = contributionMetrics.normalizedContributions,
                totalSaved = totalSaved
            )
            val bestProgressGoal = goals.maxByOrNull {
                it.currentAmount / it.targetAmount.coerceAtLeast(0.01)
            }
            val goalCrusherUnlockedAt = resolveGoalCrusherUnlockedAt(
                goals = goals,
                normalizedContributions = contributionMetrics.normalizedContributions
            )
    
            val goalCount = goals.size
            var completedGoals = 0
            for (goal in goals) {
                if (goal.currentAmount >= goal.targetAmount) {
                    completedGoals++
                }
            }
    
            return listOf(
                SavingsAchievement(
                    id = "first_goal",
                    title = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_GOAL_SETTER),
                    description = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_FIRST_GOAL),
                    icon = "ðŸŽ¯",
                    isUnlocked = goalCount >= 1,
                    unlockedAt = firstGoalUnlockedAt,
                    progress = if (goalCount >= 1) 1.0 else 0.0,
                    requirement = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_ACHIEVEMENT_REQ_CREATE_GOAL)
                ),
                SavingsAchievement(
                    id = "saving_streak_7",
                    title = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_WEEK_WARRIOR),
                    description = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_STREAK),
                    icon = "ðŸ”¥",
                    isUnlocked = contributionMetrics.historyAvailable && contributionMetrics.sevenDayStreakUnlockedAt != null,
                    unlockedAt = contributionMetrics.sevenDayStreakUnlockedAt,
                    progress = if (!contributionMetrics.historyAvailable) {
                        0.0
                    } else if (contributionMetrics.sevenDayStreakUnlockedAt != null) {
                        1.0
                    } else {
                        (contributionMetrics.currentStreakDays / 7.0).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
                    },
                    isAvailable = contributionMetrics.historyAvailable,
                    requirement = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_ACHIEVEMENT_REQ_STREAK)
                ),
                SavingsAchievement(
                    id = "century_saver",
                    title = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_CENTURY_CLUB),
                    description = UiText.fromKey(
                        DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_SAVE_TOTAL_FORMAT,
                        UiTextArg.Money(CENTURY_SAVER_THRESHOLD, currency = homeCurrency, currencyAssumption = "ASSUMED_HOME_CURRENCY", showCents = false)
                    ),
                    icon = "ðŸ’¯",
                    isUnlocked = totalSaved != null && totalSaved >= CENTURY_SAVER_THRESHOLD,
                    unlockedAt = if (totalSaved != null && totalSaved >= CENTURY_SAVER_THRESHOLD) totalSavedThresholds[CENTURY_SAVER_THRESHOLD] else null,
                    progress = totalSaved?.let { (it / CENTURY_SAVER_THRESHOLD).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0) } ?: 0.0,
                    isAvailable = totalSaved != null,
                    requirement = UiText.fromKey(
                        DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_ACHIEVEMENT_REQ_SAVED_FORMAT,
                        UiTextArg.Money(CENTURY_SAVER_THRESHOLD, currency = homeCurrency, currencyAssumption = "ASSUMED_HOME_CURRENCY", showCents = false)
                    )
                ),
                SavingsAchievement(
                    id = "goal_crusher",
                    title = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_GOAL_CRUSHER),
                    description = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_COMPLETE_FIRST_GOAL),
                    icon = "ðŸ†",
                    isUnlocked = totalSaved != null && completedGoals >= 1,
                    unlockedAt = if (totalSaved != null && completedGoals >= 1) goalCrusherUnlockedAt else null,
                    isAvailable = totalSaved != null,
                    progress = if (totalSaved == null) 0.0 else if (completedGoals >= 1) 1.0 else
                        (bestProgressGoal?.let {
                            it.currentAmount / it.targetAmount.coerceAtLeast(0.01)
                        } ?: 0.0).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0),
                    requirement = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_ACHIEVEMENT_REQ_COMPLETE_GOAL)
                ),
                SavingsAchievement(
                    id = "thousand_saver",
                    title = UiText.fromKey(DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_GRAND_SAVER),
                    description = UiText.fromKey(
                        DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_ACHIEVEMENT_DESC_SAVE_TOTAL_FORMAT,
                        UiTextArg.Money(GRAND_SAVER_THRESHOLD, currency = homeCurrency, currencyAssumption = "ASSUMED_HOME_CURRENCY", showCents = false)
                    ),
                    icon = "ðŸ’°",
                    isUnlocked = totalSaved != null && totalSaved >= GRAND_SAVER_THRESHOLD,
                    unlockedAt = if (totalSaved != null && totalSaved >= GRAND_SAVER_THRESHOLD) totalSavedThresholds[GRAND_SAVER_THRESHOLD] else null,
                    progress = totalSaved?.let { (it / GRAND_SAVER_THRESHOLD).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0) } ?: 0.0,
                    isAvailable = totalSaved != null,
                    requirement = UiText.fromKey(
                        DomainTextKeys.SAVINGS_ACHIEVEMENT_REQ_SAVED_FORMAT,
                        UiTextArg.Money(GRAND_SAVER_THRESHOLD, currency = homeCurrency, currencyAssumption = "ASSUMED_HOME_CURRENCY", showCents = false)
                    )
                )
            )
        }
    
        fun calculateLevel(totalSaved: Double): Int {
            // Level up every LEVEL_UP_EVERY in home currency
            return (totalSaved / LEVEL_UP_EVERY).toInt() + 1
        }
    
        fun getLevelTitle(level: Int): String {
            return when (level) {
                1 -> "Savings Rookie"
                2 -> "Savings Apprentice"
                3 -> "Savings Journeyman"
                4 -> "Savings Expert"
                5 -> "Savings Master"
                else -> "Savings Legend"
            }
        }
    
        private suspend fun analyzeContributionHistory(
            computationCurrency: String? = null,
            goals: List<com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.model.SavingsGoal> = emptyList()
        ): ContributionMetrics {
            val now = timeProvider.now()
            val homeCurrency = computationCurrency ?: currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first()
            val contributions = try {
                contributionHistoryRepository.getAllContributions().sortedBy { it.timestamp }
            } catch (error: SavingsContributionHistoryUnavailableException) {
                return ContributionMetrics(
                    totalContributedThisMonth = null,
                    totalContributedThisMonthResult = MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable(
                        reason = "SAVINGS_HISTORY_CORRUPT",
                        requestedRateBasis = RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                        metadata = MoneyAggregateMetadata()
                    ),
                    historyAvailable = false
                )
            }
            val normalizedContributions = normalizeContributions(contributions, homeCurrency, goals)
            val (monthStart, monthEnd) = TimePeriodUtils.getMonthRange(now)
            val currentMonthContributions = normalizedContributions.filter {
                it.event.timestamp >= monthStart && it.event.timestamp < monthEnd
            }
            val contributionMoney = aggregateNormalizedContributions(currentMonthContributions, homeCurrency)
            if (contributions.isEmpty()) {
                return ContributionMetrics(
                    totalContributedThisMonth = contributionMoney.displayAmountOrNull(),
                    totalContributedThisMonthResult = contributionMoney,
                    normalizedContributions = normalizedContributions
                )
            }
    
            val sortedContributions = contributions
            val contributionDays = sortedContributions
                .map { TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfDay(it.timestamp) }
                .distinct()
                .sorted()
    
            return ContributionMetrics(
                currentStreakDays = calculateCurrentStreakDays(contributionDays, now),
                personalBestDays = calculatePersonalBestDays(contributionDays),
                lastSavingsDate = sortedContributions.lastOrNull()?.timestamp,
                monthlyContributions = currentMonthContributions.size,
                totalContributedThisMonth = contributionMoney.displayAmountOrNull(),
                totalContributedThisMonthResult = contributionMoney,
                sevenDayStreakUnlockedAt = findStreakUnlockedAt(sortedContributions, 7),
                contributions = sortedContributions,
                normalizedContributions = normalizedContributions
            )
        }
    
        private data class NormalizedContribution(
            val event: SavingsContributionEvent,
            val homeRow: NormalizedMoneyRow?,
            val goalAmount: MoneyAmount? = null,
            val unavailableReason: String? = null
        )
    
        private suspend fun normalizeContributions(
            contributions: List<SavingsContributionEvent>,
            homeCurrencyCode: String,
            goals: List<com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.model.SavingsGoal>
        ): List<NormalizedContribution> {
            val homeCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrencyCode)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                ?: return contributions.map {
                    NormalizedContribution(it, null, unavailableReason = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_TARGET_CURRENCY.name)
                }
            val goalCurrencies = goals.filter { it.currentAmount >= it.targetAmount }.associate { goal ->
                goal.id to CurrencyCode.parse(goal.currency)?.takeIf {
                    it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED &&
                        goal.currencyAssumption != "LEGACY_DEFAULT"
                }
            }
            return contributions.map { contribution ->
                val sourceCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(contribution.currency)
                    ?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                val normalized = when {
                    sourceCurrency == null -> NormalizedContribution(
                        contribution, null, unavailableReason = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_SOURCE_CURRENCY.name
                    )
                    sourceCurrency == homeCurrency -> NormalizedContribution(
                        contribution, NormalizedMoneyRow(contribution.amount, homeCurrency, sourceCurrency)
                    )
                    else -> when (val outcome = currencyConverter.convertOutcome(
                        amount = contribution.amount,
                        fromCurrency = sourceCurrency.code,
                        toCurrency = homeCurrency.code,
                        rateBasis = RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                        atMillis = contribution.timestamp,
                        stalePolicy = StaleRatePolicy.forBasis(RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE)
                    )) {
                        is ConversionOutcome.Converted -> NormalizedContribution(
                            contribution, NormalizedMoneyRow(
                                outcome.convertedAmount, homeCurrency, sourceCurrency, rateValidDate = outcome.rateValidDate
                            )
                        )
                        is ConversionOutcome.Failed -> NormalizedContribution(
                            contribution, null, unavailableReason = outcome.failureType.name
                        )
                    }
                }
                // Compare historical contributions with the target in goal units.
                // Reuse identity/home conversions rather than valuing the target at latest FX.
                val goalCurrency = goalCurrencies[contribution.goalId]
                val goalAmount = when {
                    sourceCurrency == null || goalCurrency == null -> null
                    goalCurrency == sourceCurrency -> MoneyAmount(contribution.amount, goalCurrency)
                    goalCurrency == homeCurrency -> normalized.homeRow?.let { MoneyAmount(it.amount, goalCurrency) }
                    else -> when (val outcome = currencyConverter.convertOutcome(
                        amount = contribution.amount, fromCurrency = sourceCurrency.code, toCurrency = goalCurrency.code,
                        rateBasis = RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE, atMillis = contribution.timestamp,
                        stalePolicy = StaleRatePolicy.forBasis(RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE)
                    )) {
                        is ConversionOutcome.Converted -> MoneyAmount(outcome.convertedAmount, goalCurrency)
                        is ConversionOutcome.Failed -> null
                    }
                }
                normalized.copy(goalAmount = goalAmount)
            }
        }
    
        private fun aggregateNormalizedContributions(
            contributions: List<NormalizedContribution>,
            homeCurrencyCode: String
        ): MoneyAggregateResult {
            val homeCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrencyCode)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                ?: return MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable(
                    reason = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_TARGET_CURRENCY.name,
                    requestedRateBasis = RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                    metadata = MoneyAggregateMetadata(excludedTransactionCount = contributions.size)
                )
            val failed = contributions.count { it.homeRow == null }
            val rows = contributions.mapNotNull { it.homeRow }
            val result = MoneyAggregateBuilder.fromNormalizedRows(
                rows = rows, targetCurrency = homeCurrency,
                quality = NormalizedMoneyQuality(
                    excludedTransactionCount = failed,
                    missingRateCount = contributions.count { it.unavailableReason == "MISSING_RATE" || it.unavailableReason == "MISSING_HISTORICAL_RATE" },
                    staleRateCount = contributions.count { it.unavailableReason == "STALE_RATE" },
                    invalidCurrencyCount = contributions.count { it.unavailableReason == "INVALID_SOURCE_CURRENCY" }
                ),
                requestedRateBasis = RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                actualRateBasis = if (rows.all { it.sourceCurrency == homeCurrency }) RateBasis.IDENTITY else RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE
            )
            if (failed > 0) {
                return MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable(
                    reason = contributions.firstNotNullOfOrNull { it.unavailableReason }
                        ?: MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE.name,
                    requestedRateBasis = RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                    metadata = when (result) {
                        is MoneyAggregateResult.Available -> result.aggregate.metadata
                        is MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable -> result.metadata
                    }
                )
            }
            return result
        }
    
        suspend fun aggregateGoalBalances(
            goals: List<com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.model.SavingsGoal>,
            homeCurrencyCode: String
        ): MoneyAggregateResult {
            val homeCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrencyCode)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                ?: return MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable(
                    reason = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_TARGET_CURRENCY.name,
                    requestedRateBasis = RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE,
                    metadata = MoneyAggregateMetadata(excludedTransactionCount = goals.size)
                )
            if (goals.isEmpty()) {
                return MoneyAggregateResult.Available(MoneyAggregate.empty(homeCurrency, RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE))
            }
    
            val buckets = goals.map { goal ->
                val sourceCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(goal.currency)
                    ?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                    ?: return MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable(
                        reason = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_SOURCE_CURRENCY.name,
                        requestedRateBasis = RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE,
                        metadata = MoneyAggregateMetadata(
                            excludedTransactionCount = goals.size,
                            invalidCurrencyCount = 1
                        )
                    )
                if (goal.currencyAssumption == "LEGACY_DEFAULT") {
                    return MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable(
                        reason = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_SOURCE_CURRENCY.name,
                        requestedRateBasis = RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE,
                        metadata = MoneyAggregateMetadata(
                            excludedTransactionCount = goals.size,
                            invalidCurrencyCount = 1
                        ),
                        warningMessage = "Savings goal currency provenance is unavailable"
                    )
                }
                MoneyBucketInput(
                    amount = goal.currentAmount,
                    currency = sourceCurrency,
                    transactionCount = 1
                )
            }
            val aggregate = MoneyAggregateBuilder.fromBuckets(
                buckets = buckets,
                homeCurrency = homeCurrency,
                converter = currencyConverter,
                rateBasis = RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE,
                bucketDatePolicy = BucketDatePolicy.Latest
            )
            return if (aggregate.conversionQuality == ConversionQuality.UNAVAILABLE) {
                MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable(
                    reason = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE.name,
                    requestedRateBasis = RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE,
                    metadata = aggregate.metadata,
                    warningMessage = aggregate.warningMessage
                        ?: MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE.name
                )
            } else {
                MoneyAggregateResult.Available(aggregate)
            }
        }
    
        private fun MoneyAggregateResult.displayAmountOrNull(): Double? =
            (this as? MoneyAggregateResult.Available)
                ?.aggregate
                ?.takeIf { it.conversionQuality == ConversionQuality.COMPLETE }
                ?.displayAmount
    
        private suspend fun resolveTotalSavedThresholdUnlocks(
            goals: List<com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.model.SavingsGoal>,
            normalizedContributions: List<NormalizedContribution>,
            totalSaved: Double?
        ): Map<Double, Long?> {
            val thresholds = listOf(CENTURY_SAVER_THRESHOLD, GRAND_SAVER_THRESHOLD)
            val unlocks = thresholds.associateWith { null as Long? }.toMutableMap()
            var cumulativeSaved = 0.0
            for (normalized in normalizedContributions) {
                val amount = normalized.homeRow?.amount ?: break
                cumulativeSaved += amount
                for (threshold in thresholds) {
                    if (unlocks[threshold] == null && cumulativeSaved >= threshold) {
                        unlocks[threshold] = normalized.event.timestamp
                    }
                }
                if (unlocks.values.all { it != null }) break
            }
    
            val fallbackTimestamp = goals.minOfOrNull { it.createdAt }
            for (threshold in thresholds) {
                if (normalizedContributions.isEmpty() && unlocks[threshold] == null && totalSaved != null && totalSaved >= threshold) {
                    unlocks[threshold] = fallbackTimestamp
                }
            }
            return unlocks
        }
    
        private suspend fun resolveGoalCrusherUnlockedAt(
            goals: List<com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.model.SavingsGoal>,
            normalizedContributions: List<NormalizedContribution>
        ): Long? {
            val completedGoalIds = goals
                .filter { it.currentAmount >= it.targetAmount }
                .associateBy { it.id }
    
            if (completedGoalIds.isEmpty()) {
                return null
            }
    
            val totalsByGoal = mutableMapOf<Long, Double>()
            val unresolvedGoals = mutableSetOf<Long>()
            for (normalized in normalizedContributions) {
                val goalId = normalized.event.goalId
                val goal = completedGoalIds[goalId] ?: continue
                if (goalId in unresolvedGoals) continue
                val amount = normalized.goalAmount?.takeIf { it.currency == CurrencyCode.parse(goal.currency) }?.amount
                if (amount == null) {
                    unresolvedGoals += goalId
                    continue
                }
                val updatedAmount = (totalsByGoal[goalId] ?: 0.0) + amount
                totalsByGoal[goalId] = updatedAmount
                // Chronological events make the first valid crossing the earliest
                // across goals, independently of their creation/list order.
                if (updatedAmount >= goal.targetAmount) return normalized.event.timestamp
            }
            return null
        }
    
        private fun calculateCurrentStreakDays(contributionDays: List<Long>, referenceTime: Long): Int {
            if (contributionDays.isEmpty()) return 0
    
            val today = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfDay(referenceTime)
            val yesterday = TimePeriodUtils.addDays(today, -1)
            val latestContributionDay = contributionDays.last()
            if (latestContributionDay < yesterday) return 0
    
            var streak = 1
            var expectedPreviousDay = TimePeriodUtils.addDays(latestContributionDay, -1)
    
            for (index in contributionDays.lastIndex - 1 downTo 0) {
                val currentDay = contributionDays[index]
                if (currentDay == expectedPreviousDay) {
                    streak++
                    expectedPreviousDay = TimePeriodUtils.addDays(expectedPreviousDay, -1)
                } else if (currentDay < expectedPreviousDay) {
                    break
                }
            }
    
            return streak
        }
    
        private fun calculatePersonalBestDays(contributionDays: List<Long>): Int {
            if (contributionDays.isEmpty()) return 0
    
            var best = 1
            var current = 1
    
            for (index in 1 until contributionDays.size) {
                current = if (contributionDays[index] == TimePeriodUtils.addDays(contributionDays[index - 1], 1)) {
                    current + 1
                } else {
                    1
                }
                best = maxOf(best, current)
            }
    
            return best
        }
    
        private fun findStreakUnlockedAt(
            contributions: List<SavingsContributionEvent>,
            targetDays: Int
        ): Long? {
            if (targetDays <= 0 || contributions.isEmpty()) return null
    
            val latestTimestampByDay = linkedMapOf<Long, Long>()
            for (contribution in contributions) {
                val contributionDay = TimePeriodUtils.getStartOfDay(contribution.timestamp)
                val currentLatest = latestTimestampByDay[contributionDay]
                if (currentLatest == null || contribution.timestamp > currentLatest) {
                    latestTimestampByDay[contributionDay] = contribution.timestamp
                }
            }
    
            val contributionDays = latestTimestampByDay.keys.sorted()
            var runLength = 0
            var previousDay: Long? = null
    
            for (contributionDay in contributionDays) {
                runLength = if (
                    previousDay != null &&
                    contributionDay == TimePeriodUtils.addDays(previousDay, 1)
                ) {
                    runLength + 1
                } else {
                    1
                }
    
                if (runLength >= targetDays) {
                    return latestTimestampByDay[contributionDay]
                }
    
                previousDay = contributionDay
            }
    
            return null
        }
    
        private data class ContributionMetrics(
            val currentStreakDays: Int = 0,
            val personalBestDays: Int = 0,
            val lastSavingsDate: Long? = null,
            val monthlyContributions: Int = 0,
            val totalContributedThisMonth: Double? = 0.0,
            val totalContributedThisMonthResult: MoneyAggregateResult? = null,
            val sevenDayStreakUnlockedAt: Long? = null,
            val contributions: List<SavingsContributionEvent> = emptyList(),
            val normalizedContributions: List<NormalizedContribution> = emptyList(),
            val historyAvailable: Boolean = true
        )
    }
