    /**
     * Why a particular currency was assigned to an entity or amount.
     *
     * This exists because the app has historical data where currency was not stored,
     * and we need to distinguish "the user explicitly chose EUR" from "the app defaulted
     * to EUR because older versions didn't have a currency field."
     *
     * Rule: Unknown currency must never silently become EUR.
     * This enum makes the assumption visible.
     */
    enum class CurrencyAssumption(val serializedName: String) {
    
        /** Currency is completely unknown â€” no basis for assignment. */
        UNKNOWN("UNKNOWN"),
    
        /** We assumed the user's home currency because the source didn't specify one. */
        ASSUMED_HOME_CURRENCY("ASSUMED_HOME_CURRENCY"),
    
        /** Legacy data: older app versions defaulted to EUR without storing currency. */
        ASSUMED_LEGACY_EUR("ASSUMED_LEGACY_EUR"),
    
        /** The user explicitly confirmed or selected this currency. */
        USER_CONFIRMED("USER_CONFIRMED"),
    
        /** Currency was parsed from a data source (receipt, bank statement, notification). */
        PARSED_FROM_SOURCE("PARSED_FROM_SOURCE");
    
        /** Whether this assumption indicates the currency might be wrong. */
        val isUncertain: Boolean
            get() = this == UNKNOWN || this == ASSUMED_HOME_CURRENCY || this == ASSUMED_LEGACY_EUR
    
        companion object {
            /** Deserialize from stored string, defaulting to UNKNOWN for unrecognized values. */
            fun fromSerializedName(name: String): CurrencyAssumption =
                values().find { it.serializedName == name } ?: UNKNOWN
        }
    }

        ) : SmartSavingsComputationResult
    }
    
    enum class RecommendationSource {
        BUDGET_SURPLUS,
        SPENDING_PACE,
        MONTE_CARLO,
        INCOME_DEPOSIT,
        ROUND_UP
    }
    
    @Singleton
    class SmartSavingsEngine @Inject constructor(
        private val expenseRepository: ExpenseRepository,
        private val categoryRepository: CategoryRepository,
        private val budgetRepository: BudgetRepository,
        private val budgetCalculator: BudgetCalculator,
        private val monteCarloSimulator: MonteCarloSpendingSimulator,
        private val timeProvider: TimeProvider,
        private val analyticsCurrencyNormalizer: AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer,
        /** AI-4: CashFlowCalculator provides the canonical list of upcoming recurring obligations. */
        private val cashFlowCalculator: CashFlowCalculator,
        /** AIML-30: SpendingThresholdCalculator for adaptive caps instead of hardcoded values. */
        private val spendingThresholdCalculator: SpendingThresholdCalculator
    ) {
        companion object {
            private const val DAY_IN_MILLIS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L
    
            /**
             * Default weekly safe-save cap, denominated in the user's home currency.
             *
             * These caps represent conservative upper bounds on how much the engine
             * will recommend saving in a single week/month/quarter. They prevent
             * overly aggressive savings recommendations. Values are in home-currency
             * units (e.g., EUR, USD) and should be tuned per-market. Future iterations
             * may expose these as user-editable settings via [CurrencySettingsRepository].
             */
            /**
             * Fallback monthly discretionary spending used when historical data is
             * insufficient to compute a user-specific baseline. Denominated in home
             * currency.
             */
            private const val DEFAULT_FALLBACK_MONTHLY_DISCRETIONARY = 500.0
        }
    
        @Deprecated("Presentation compatibility only; use calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult")
        suspend fun calculateSafeToSaveAmount(
            goal: SavingsGoal,
            timeHorizon: TimeHorizon = TimeHorizon.MONTH,
            homeCurrency: String
        ): SavingsRecommendation {
            val targetCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
            if (targetCurrency == null || CurrencyCode.parse(goal.currency) != targetCurrency) {
                return SavingsRecommendation(
                    safeAmount = 0.0,
                    confidence = 0.0,
                    impact = "Savings recommendation unavailable",
                    source = RecommendationSource.BUDGET_SURPLUS,
                    currency = homeCurrency,
                    isAvailable = false
                )
            }
    
            return try {
                val recommendation = calculatePortfolioSafeToSaveAmount(
                    goal, timeHorizon, homeCurrency, SavingsDecisionQuality(homeCurrency)
                )
                val allocation = allocateAcrossGoals(listOf(goal), recommendation.safeAmount).single()
                recommendation.copy(safeAmount = allocation)
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: MoneyDisplayUnavailableException) {
                SavingsRecommendation(
                    safeAmount = 0.0,
                    confidence = 0.0,
                    impact = "Savings recommendation unavailable",
                    source = RecommendationSource.BUDGET_SURPLUS,
                    currency = homeCurrency,
                    isAvailable = false
                )
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                SavingsRecommendation(
                    safeAmount = 0.0,
                    confidence = 0.0,
                    impact = "Savings recommendation unavailable",
                    source = RecommendationSource.BUDGET_SURPLUS,
                    currency = homeCurrency,
                    isAvailable = false
                )
            }
        }
    
        @Deprecated("Presentation compatibility only; use calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult")
        suspend fun calculatePortfolioRecommendations(
            goals: List<SavingsGoal>,
            timeHorizon: TimeHorizon = TimeHorizon.MONTH,
            homeCurrency: String
        ): List<GoalSavingsRecommendation> =
            (calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(goals, timeHorizon, homeCurrency)
                as? SmartSavingsComputationResult.Available)
                ?.recommendations
                ?: emptyList()
    
        suspend fun calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(
            goals: List<SavingsGoal>,
            timeHorizon: TimeHorizon = TimeHorizon.MONTH,
            homeCurrency: String
        ): SmartSavingsComputationResult {
            val targetCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                ?: return SmartSavingsComputationResult.Unavailable(
                    reasonCode = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_TARGET_CURRENCY.name,
                    metadata = SavingsDecisionQuality(homeCurrency).snapshot(unavailable = true)
                )
            val incompleteGoals = goals.filter { goal ->
                (goal.targetAmount - goal.currentAmount) > 0.0 &&
                    CurrencyCode.parse(goal.currency) == targetCurrency
            }
    
            if (incompleteGoals.isEmpty()) {
                return SmartSavingsComputationResult.NoRecommendation(
                    metadata = SavingsDecisionQuality(homeCurrency).snapshot()
                )
            }
    
            val quality = SavingsDecisionQuality(homeCurrency)
            val portfolioRecommendation = try {
                calculatePortfolioSafeToSaveAmount(
                    sampleGoal = incompleteGoals.first(),
                    timeHorizon = timeHorizon,
                    homeCurrency = homeCurrency,
                    quality = quality
                )
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: MoneyDisplayUnavailableException) {
                return SmartSavingsComputationResult.Unavailable(
                    reasonCode = error.reasonCode.name,
                    metadata = quality.snapshot(unavailable = true)
                )
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                return SmartSavingsComputationResult.Unavailable(
                    reasonCode = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE.name,
                    metadata = quality.snapshot(unavailable = true)
                )
            }
    
            if (portfolioRecommendation.safeAmount <= 0.0) {
                return SmartSavingsComputationResult.NoRecommendation(quality.snapshot())
            }
    
            val allocations = allocateAcrossGoals(incompleteGoals, portfolioRecommendation.safeAmount)
            val recommendations = incompleteGoals.mapIndexedNotNull { index, goal ->
                val allocatedAmount = allocations.getOrElse(index) { 0.0 }
                if (allocatedAmount <= 0.0) {
                    null
                } else {
                    GoalSavingsRecommendation(
                        goal = goal,
                        recommendation = portfolioRecommendation.copy(
                            safeAmount = allocatedAmount,
                            impact = generateImpactMessage(allocatedAmount, goal, timeHorizon, homeCurrency)
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
    
            return if (recommendations.isEmpty()) {
                SmartSavingsComputationResult.NoRecommendation(quality.snapshot())
            } else {
                SmartSavingsComputationResult.Available(
                    recommendations = recommendations,
                    metadata = quality.snapshot()
                )
            }
        }

    /**
     * Monthly Savings Sweep Use Case.
     *
     * Computes end-of-month savings sweep recommendations by analyzing:
     * 1. Budget underspend across all categories
     * 2. Monte Carlo risk buffer for spending uncertainty
     * 3. Safe sweep amount = underspend - riskBuffer
     * 4. Allocation across active savings goals based on urgency
     *
     * ## Formula
     * ```
     * safeSweep = max(0, underspend - riskBuffer)
     * where:
     * - underspend = overall remaining (if overall budget exists) OR sum of category remaining
     * - riskBuffer = MC uncertainty buffer (p75 - p50)
     * ```
     */
    @Singleton
    class MonthlySavingsSweepUseCase @Inject constructor(
        private val budgetRepository: BudgetRepository,
        private val savingsGoalRepository: SavingsGoalRepository,
        private val expenseRepository: ExpenseRepository,
        private val recurringExpenseRepository: RecurringExpenseRepository,
        private val plannedExpenseRepository: PlannedExpenseRepository,
        private val monteCarloSimulator: MonteCarloSpendingSimulator,
        private val timeProvider: TimeProvider,
        private val analyticsCurrencyNormalizer: AnalyticsCurrencyNormalizer,
        private val currencySettingsRepository: CurrencySettingsRepository,
        private val currencyConverter: CurrencyConverter,
        private val recurringOccurrenceDao: RecurringOccurrenceDao
    ) {
        companion object {
            /** Minimum safe sweep amount to show recommendation (in home currency) */
            const val MIN_SWEEP_AMOUNT = 5.0
    
            /** Days before month-end to start showing sweep recommendations */
            const val DAYS_BEFORE_MONTH_END = 5
    
            /** Confidence threshold for showing recommendations */
            const val MIN_CONFIDENCE = 0.4
    
            /** Maximum single allocation as percentage of safe sweep */
            const val MAX_SINGLE_ALLOCATION_PERCENT = 0.8
        }
    
        /**
         * Typed decision boundary. `Unavailable` is distinct from a valid empty/no-op
         * recommendation so callers cannot silently flatten failed money input to null.
         */
        suspend fun computeSweepRecommendationResult(): SavingsSweepComputationResult {
            val quality = SavingsDecisionQuality("")
            return try {
                computeAvailableSweepRecommendation(quality)?.let {
                    SavingsSweepComputationResult.Available(it, quality.snapshot())
                }
                    ?: SavingsSweepComputationResult.NoRecommendation(quality.snapshot())
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: MoneyDisplayUnavailableException) {
                SavingsSweepComputationResult.Unavailable(error.reasonCode.name, quality.snapshot(unavailable = true))
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                SavingsSweepComputationResult.Unavailable(
                    MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE.name,
                    quality.snapshot(unavailable = true)
                )
            }
        }
    
        /** Compatibility adapter for legacy nullable presentation callers. */
        @Deprecated("Presentation compatibility only; use computeSweepRecommendationResult")
        suspend fun computeSweepRecommendation(): SavingsSweepRecommendation? =
            (computeSweepRecommendationResult() as? SavingsSweepComputationResult.Available)?.recommendation
    
        private suspend fun computeAvailableSweepRecommendation(quality: SavingsDecisionQuality): SavingsSweepRecommendation? {
            val now = timeProvider.now()
            val settings = try {
                withTimeoutOrNull(5_000L) {
                    val currency = currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first()
                    quality.currency = currency
                    currency to currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().first()
                } ?: quality.fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.HOME_CURRENCY_UNAVAILABLE)
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                quality.fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.HOME_CURRENCY_UNAVAILABLE)
            }
            val (homeCurrency, rateTimestamp) = settings
            quality.currency = homeCurrency
            quality.settingsRateTimestamp = rateTimestamp
            val targetCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                ?: quality.fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_TARGET_CURRENCY)
            // G-TIME-01: derive calendar fields from the injected TimeProvider instant
            // (java.time, system default timezone â€” same field values the Calendar read).
            val zone = ZoneId.systemDefault()
            val today = Instant.ofEpochMilli(now).atZone(zone).toLocalDate()
    
            // Check if we're within the recommendation window (last N days of month)
            if (!isWithinSweepWindow(today)) {
                Timber.d("Not within sweep window, skipping")
                return null
            }
    
            // Calculate month boundaries
            val daysInMonth = today.lengthOfMonth()
            val dayOfMonth = today.dayOfMonth
            val daysRemaining = daysInMonth - dayOfMonth
    
            val monthStart = today.withDayOfMonth(1).atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
            val nextMonthStart = today.withDayOfMonth(1).plusMonths(1).atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
            val monthEndInclusive = nextMonthStart - 1L
    
            // Get budget statuses and calculate underspend
            val budgetStatuses = budgetRepository.getBudgetStatuses().first()
            if (budgetStatuses.any { it.isPartial || !it.percentKnown ||
                    it.conversionWarning != null ||
                    CurrencyCode.parse(it.currency) != targetCurrency ||
                    CurrencyCode.parse(it.budget.currency) != targetCurrency }) {
                quality.fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE)
            }
            if (budgetStatuses.any { !it.remainingAmount.isFinite() || !it.spentAmount.isFinite() ||
                    !it.budget.amount.isFinite() }) quality.fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_AMOUNT)
            if (budgetStatuses.isEmpty()) {
                Timber.d("No active budgets, skipping sweep")
                return null
            }
    
            val (underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent) = calculateUnderspend(budgetStatuses)
            if (listOf(underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent).any { !it.isFinite() }) {
                quality.fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_AMOUNT)
            }
            if (underspend <= 0) {
                Timber.d("SAVINGS_SWEEP_NO_UNDERSPEND")
                return null
            }
    
            // Calculate spent to date for Monte Carlo (normalized to home currency)
            val spentToDate = calculateSpentToDate(monthStart, now, homeCurrency, quality)
            val knownUpcoming = calculateKnownUpcomingObligations(now, nextMonthStart, homeCurrency, quality)
    
            // Run Monte Carlo simulation
            val monteCarloResult = monteCarloSimulator.simulate(
                spentToDate = spentToDate,
                knownUpcoming = knownUpcoming,
                budgetAmount = totalBudgeted,
                displayCurrency = homeCurrency
            )
            quality.requireForecast(monteCarloResult)
    
            // Calculate risk buffer from Monte Carlo uncertainty
            val riskBuffer = calculateRiskBuffer(
                monteCarloResult = monteCarloResult,
                spentToDate = spentToDate,
                knownUpcoming = knownUpcoming,
                budgetAmount = totalBudgeted,
                currentDayOfMonth = dayOfMonth,
                daysRemaining = daysRemaining
            )
    
            // Calculate safe sweep amount
            val safeSweepAmount = (underspend - riskBuffer).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
            if (safeSweepAmount < MIN_SWEEP_AMOUNT) {
                Timber.d("SAVINGS_SWEEP_BELOW_MINIMUM")
                return null
            }
    
            // Get active goals
            val goals = savingsGoalRepository.observeSavingsGoals().first()
                .filter { it.targetAmount > 0.0 && it.currentAmount < it.targetAmount &&
                    CurrencyCode.parse(it.currency) == targetCurrency }
    
            if (goals.isEmpty()) {
                Timber.d("No active savings goals, skipping sweep")
                return null
            }
    
            // Calculate goal allocations
            val allocations = allocateAcrossGoals(safeSweepAmount, goals).map { it.copy(currency = homeCurrency) }
    
            // Calculate confidence score
            val confidence = calculateConfidence(
                underspend = underspend,
                riskBuffer = riskBuffer,
                monteCarloConfidence = monteCarloResult?.confidence?.score ?: 0.5,
                daysRemaining = daysRemaining,
                goalCount = goals.size
            )
    
            if (confidence < MIN_CONFIDENCE) {
                Timber.d("SAVINGS_SWEEP_LOW_CONFIDENCE")
                return null
            }
    
            return SavingsSweepRecommendation(
                totalUnderspend = underspend,
                riskBuffer = riskBuffer,
                safeSweepAmount = safeSweepAmount,
                goalAllocations = allocations,
                computedAt = now,
                monthEnd = monthEndInclusive,
                confidence = confidence,
                currency = homeCurrency,
                rateTimestamp = rateTimestamp
            )
        }
    
        /**
         * Check if we're within the sweep recommendation window.
         * Returns true during the last [DAYS_BEFORE_MONTH_END] days of the month.
         */
        private fun isWithinSweepWindow(today: LocalDate): Boolean {
            val daysInMonth = today.lengthOfMonth()
            val dayOfMonth = today.dayOfMonth
            return dayOfMonth >= (daysInMonth - DAYS_BEFORE_MONTH_END + 1)
        }
    
        /**
         * Calculate total underspend across all budget categories.
         * Only counts remaining amounts (not overspent budgets).
         *
         * @return Triple of (underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent)
         */
        private fun calculateUnderspend(budgetStatuses: List<BudgetStatus>): Triple<Double, Double, Double> {
            val overallBudget = budgetStatuses.firstOrNull { it.budget.categoryId == null }
            val selectedStatuses = if (overallBudget != null) {
                listOf(overallBudget)
            } else {
                budgetStatuses.filter { it.budget.categoryId != null }
            }
    
            val underspend = selectedStatuses.sumOf { status ->
                status.remainingAmount.coerceAtLeast(0.0)
            }
            // T4C oracle: the sweep risk baseline uses the budgeted amount.
            // effectiveLimit is a BudgetMonitor display concept and is 0 in
            // legacy status snapshots, which would zero the budget-based
            // fallback risk buffer.
            val totalBudgeted = selectedStatuses.sumOf { it.budget.amount }
            val totalSpent = selectedStatuses.sumOf { it.spentAmount }
    
            return Triple(underspend, totalBudgeted, totalSpent)
        }

    @HiltViewModel
    class SavingsGoalsViewModel @Inject constructor(
        private val savingsGoalRepository: SavingsGoalRepository,
        private val savingsContributionHistoryRepository: SavingsContributionHistoryRepository,

    ) : ViewModel() {

        val state: StateFlow<SavingsGoalsState> = _state.asStateFlow()

        private var recommendationComputationId = 0L
    
     init {
     loadGoals()
     loadLifestyleRecommendation()
     checkSweepAvailability()
     }
    
        private fun loadGoals() {
            goalsCollectionJob?.cancel()
            goalsCollectionJob = viewModelScope.launch {
                _state.update { it.copy(isLoading = true) }
    
                combine(
                    savingsGoalRepository.observeSavingsGoals(),
                    currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().distinctUntilChanged(),
                    currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().distinctUntilChanged()
                ) { goals, currency, rateTimestamp -> Triple(goals, currency, rateTimestamp) }
                    .collectLatest { (goals, homeCurrency, rateTimestamp) ->
                        val computationId = ++recommendationComputationId
                        _state.update { it.copy(
                            isLoading = true, homeCurrency = homeCurrency, totalSaved = null,
                            totalSavedResult = null, userLevel = null, levelTitle = "Unavailable",
                            smartRecommendations = emptyList(), smartComputationResult = null,
                            sweepRecommendation = null, sweepUnavailableReason = null, sweepComputationResult = null,
                            achievements = emptyList()
                        ) }
                        val totalSavedResult = gamificationEngine.aggregateGoalBalances(goals, homeCurrency)
                        val totalSaved = totalSavedResult.completeDisplayAmountOrNull(homeCurrency)
                        val level = totalSaved?.let(gamificationEngine::calculateLevel)
                        val title = level?.let(gamificationEngine::getLevelTitle) ?: "Unavailable"
    
                        val smartResult = smartSavingsEngine.calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(
                            goals = goals,
                            timeHorizon = SmartSavingsEngine.TimeHorizon.MONTH,
                            homeCurrency = homeCurrency
                        )
                        val portfolioRecommendations = (smartResult as? SmartSavingsComputationResult.Available)
                            ?.recommendations.orEmpty()
    
                        // Generate smart recommendations
                        val recommendations = portfolioRecommendations.mapNotNull { goalRecommendation ->
                            val rec = goalRecommendation.recommendation
    
                            if (rec.isAvailable && rec.safeAmount > 5.0 &&
                                CurrencyCode.parse(rec.currency) == CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency) &&
                                CurrencyCode.parse(goalRecommendation.goal.currency) == CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency)
                            ) {
                                SmartRecommendation(
                                    goal = goalRecommendation.goal,
                                    recommendedAmount = rec.safeAmount,
                                    confidence = rec.confidence,
                                    impact = rec.impact,
                                    source = rec.source.name.replace("_", " "),
                                    currency = rec.currency,
                                    rateTimestamp = rateTimestamp,
                                    computationId = computationId
                                )
                            } else null
                        }
    
                        val streak = gamificationEngine.calculateStreak()
                        val achievements = gamificationEngine.getAchievements(homeCurrency = homeCurrency)
                        if (currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first() != homeCurrency ||
                            currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().first() != rateTimestamp) return@collectLatest
                        _state.update {
                            it.copy(
                                goals = goals,
                                smartRecommendations = recommendations,
                                smartComputationResult = smartResult,
                                isLoading = false,
                                totalSaved = totalSaved,
                                totalSavedResult = totalSavedResult,
                                homeCurrency = homeCurrency,
                                streak = streak,
                                achievements = achievements,
                                userLevel = level,
                                levelTitle = title
                            )
                        }
                    }
            }
        }
    
        private fun loadGamification() {
            loadGoals()
        }
    
        private fun loadLifestyleRecommendation() {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                val recommendation = lifestyleSavingsPromptUseCase.evaluateAndPrompt()
                _state.update {
                    it.copy(lifestyleRecommendation = recommendation)
                }
            }
        }
    
        /**
         * Check if sweep recommendations are available (month-end window).
         */
        private fun checkSweepAvailability() {
            val isAvailable = monthlySavingsSweepUseCase.shouldShowSweepPrompt()
            _state.update { it.copy(isSweepAvailable = isAvailable) }
    
            if (isAvailable) {
                computeSweepRecommendation()
            }
        }
    
        /**
         * Compute the monthly savings sweep recommendation.
         */
        fun computeSweepRecommendation() {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                val result = monthlySavingsSweepUseCase.computeSweepRecommendationResult()
                val recommendation = (result as? SavingsSweepComputationResult.Available)?.recommendation
                if (recommendation != null && (recommendation.currency != currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first() ||
                        recommendation.rateTimestamp != currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().first())) return@launch
                _state.update {
                    it.copy(
                        sweepRecommendation = recommendation,
                        sweepComputationResult = result,
                        sweepUnavailableReason = (result as? SavingsSweepComputationResult.Unavailable)?.reasonCode
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    
        /**
         * Accept the sweep recommendation and allocate to goals.
         */
        fun acceptSweepRecommendation() {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                val recommendation = _state.value.sweepRecommendation ?: return@launch
                val homeCurrency = currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first()
                if (recommendation.currency != homeCurrency || recommendation.rateTimestamp != currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().first()) return@launch
                val refreshed = (monthlySavingsSweepUseCase.computeSweepRecommendationResult()
                    as? SavingsSweepComputationResult.Available)?.recommendation ?: return@launch
                if (refreshed.copy(computedAt = recommendation.computedAt) != recommendation) return@launch
                val goalsById = savingsGoalRepository.observeSavingsGoals().first().associateBy { it.id }
                if (recommendation.goalAllocations.any { allocation ->
                    val goal = goalsById[allocation.goalId]
                    goal == null || goal.currency != homeCurrency || allocation.moneySuggestedAllocation?.currency != CurrencyCode.parse(goal.currency) || goal.currentAmount != allocation.currentProgress ||
                        goal.targetAmount != allocation.targetAmount
                }) return@launch
    
                // Room and DataStore are separate persistence boundaries, so this UI
                // path cannot provide batch atomicity. Do not partially apply a
                // multi-goal recommendation until an owner-level transaction exists.
                if (recommendation.goalAllocations.size != 1) return@launch
    
                // The repository increment is atomic for this single-goal contract.
                for (allocation in recommendation.goalAllocations) {
                    if (currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first() != homeCurrency ||
                        recommendation.rateTimestamp != currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().first()) return@launch
                    val wasAdded = savingsGoalRepository.incrementSavingsGoalAmount(
                        allocation.goalId,
                        requireNotNull(allocation.moneySuggestedAllocation).amount
                    )
                    if (wasAdded) {
                        val recorded = savingsContributionHistoryRepository.recordContribution(
                            goalId = allocation.goalId,
                            amount = allocation.suggestedAllocation,
                            currency = recommendation.currency,
                            source = "sweep"
                        )
                        if (!recorded) return@launch
                    }
                }
    
                // Clear the recommendation
                _state.update { it.copy(sweepRecommendation = null, sweepUnavailableReason = null) }
    
                // Refresh gamification
                loadGamification()
            }
        }
    
        /**
         * Dismiss the sweep recommendation without applying.
         */
        fun dismissSweepRecommendation() {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                _state.update { it.copy(sweepRecommendation = null, sweepUnavailableReason = null) }
            }
        }
    
        fun acceptLifestyleRecommendation(goalId: Long?) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                lifestyleSavingsPromptUseCase.recordAcceptance(goalId)
                _state.update { it.copy(lifestyleRecommendation = null) }
            }
        }
    
        fun dismissLifestyleRecommendation(reason: String? = null) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                lifestyleSavingsPromptUseCase.recordDismissal(reason)
                _state.update { it.copy(lifestyleRecommendation = null) }
            }
        }
    
        fun addGoal(name: String, targetAmount: Double, targetDate: Long?, protectionLevel: GoalProtectionLevel) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                val goal = SavingsGoal(
                    id = 0L,
                    name = name,
                    targetAmount = targetAmount,
                    currentAmount = 0.0,
                    targetDate = targetDate,
                    protectionLevel = protectionLevel,
                    currency = currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first(),
                    currencyAssumption = "EXPLICIT_HOME_CURRENCY",
                    createdAt = timeProvider.now()
                )
                savingsGoalRepository.createSavingsGoal(goal)
                loadGamification() // Refresh level/achievements
            }
        }
    
        fun acceptSmartRecommendation(recommendation: SmartRecommendation) {
            if (recommendation !in _state.value.smartRecommendations) return
            val amount = recommendation.moneyRecommendedAmount ?: return
            contributeToGoal(recommendation.goal.id, amount.amount, amount.currency.code, recommendation)
        }
    
        fun contributeToGoal(goalId: Long, amount: Double, expectedCurrency: String? = null, recommendation: SmartRecommendation? = null) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                val goals = savingsGoalRepository.observeSavingsGoals().first()
                val goal = goals
                    .firstOrNull { it.id == goalId }
                    ?: return@launch
                if (CurrencyCode.parse(goal.currency)?.let { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED } != true) return@launch
                if (expectedCurrency != null && expectedCurrency != goal.currency) return@launch
                if (recommendation != null && (recommendation !in _state.value.smartRecommendations ||
                        recommendation.goal != goal ||
                        recommendation.currency != currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first() ||
                        recommendation.rateTimestamp != currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().first())) return@launch
                if (recommendation != null) {
                    val result = smartSavingsEngine.calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(
                        goals, SmartSavingsEngine.TimeHorizon.MONTH, recommendation.currency
                    )
                    if (result !is SmartSavingsComputationResult.Available) {
                        _state.update { it.copy(smartRecommendations = emptyList(), smartComputationResult = result) }
                        return@launch
                    }
                    val current = result.recommendations.firstOrNull { it.goal.id == goalId } ?: return@launch
                    if (!current.recommendation.isAvailable || current.recommendation.moneySafeAmount != recommendation.moneyRecommendedAmount ||
                        recommendation !in _state.value.smartRecommendations ||
                        recommendation.currency != currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first() ||
                        recommendation.rateTimestamp != currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().first()) return@launch
                }
                val wasAdded = savingsGoalRepository.incrementSavingsGoalAmount(goalId, amount)
                if (wasAdded) {
                    savingsContributionHistoryRepository.recordContribution(
                        goalId = goalId,
                        amount = amount,
                        currency = goal.currency,
                        source = "manual"
                    )
                    loadGamification()
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun MoneyAggregateResult.completeDisplayAmountOrNull(targetCurrency: String): Double? =
            (this as? MoneyAggregateResult.Available)
                ?.aggregate
                ?.takeIf { !it.isPartial && it.conversionQuality == ConversionQuality.COMPLETE &&
                    it.displayCurrency == CurrencyCode.parse(targetCurrency) }
                ?.displayAmount
    
        fun deleteGoal(goal: SavingsGoal) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                savingsGoalRepository.deleteSavingsGoal(goal)
            }
        }
    
        fun selectGoal(goal: SavingsGoal?) {
            _state.update { it.copy(selectedGoal = goal) }
        }
    
     fun refresh() {
     loadGoals()
     loadLifestyleRecommendation()
     checkSweepAvailability()
     }

    name: review-strict
    description: Strict review of the current uncommitted diff with architecture, privacy, and test checks. Use when the user asks for a strict review of current changes.
    ---
    
    # Review Strict
    
    Review the current uncommitted worktree diff. Extra plan/context comes from the invoking message.
    
    Delegate the review to the `reviewer-strict` agent.
    
    ## Instructions
    
    1. Inspect `git status`.
    2. Inspect `git diff`.
    3. Identify changed files.
    4. Read surrounding code and relevant call sites.
    5. Compare against the provided plan/context if any.
    6. Check architecture, privacy/security, tests, and regression risk.
    7. If the diff touches guard scripts, baselines, allowlists, or exceptions, verify none are weakened and cite `FINAL_CI_GUARD_ACCEPTANCE_GATE.md` FG-03/FG-06/FG-07/FG-23.
    8. Do not edit files.
    9. Report only concrete, evidence-backed issues.
    10. If no approved plan is available, say so and review against the diff and repository rules.
    
    ## Strict focus
    
    Always check carefully if the diff touches:
    
    - workers / WorkManager
    - privacy/security/permissions
    - diagnostics/logging persistence
    - Room entities/DAOs/migrations/schema
    - backup/restore/export/cloud AI
    - money/currency
    - transaction/receipt/recurring lifecycle
    - static architecture guards
    - cross-layer/cross-module changes
    
    ## Output format
    
    ```markdown
    VERDICT: PASS | FAIL
    
    Summary:
    - Changed scope: ...
    - Plan available: yes|no
    - Main risk areas checked: ...
    - Architecture docs/rules checked: ...
    
    Issues:
    - [ISSUE-1] [CRITICAL|MAJOR|MINOR] problem - `file` - why it matters - minimal fix
    
    Coverage:
    - Requirements met: yes|no|unknown
    - Testing adequate: yes|no
    - Regression risk: low|medium|high
    
    Questions:
    - ...
    
    Notes:
    - ...
    ```
    
    If there are no issues:
    
    ```markdown
    Issues:
    - None
    ```

    name: run-validation
    description: Run one serialized compile, test, lint, or guard profile through the durable validation runner and report its result.
    ---
    
    # Run Validation
    
    Use the `validation-runner` agent. It is the sole owner of live compilation,
    test, lint, connected-test, and guard execution.
    
    ## Rules
    
    1. Use only `scripts/validation-runner.ps1`; never invoke Gradle or guard
       scripts directly.
    2. Start one allowlisted profile and capture the run ID.
    3. Poll `Status`. Exit code 3 means RUNNING, not failure.
    4. Do not start concurrent validation.
    5. PASS requires both a PASS result and completion marker.
    6. Route failures to `ci-build-debugger`/coder; the runner never edits.
    7. Guard execution is verification-only; never alter baselines, allowlists,
       exceptions, or policy.
    8. Use heartbeat/output timestamps and byte counts to detect stalled output.
    9. Prefer named serial shards over the full suite for broad local evidence.
    10. Treat app-check and static-guards as distinct gates; do not skip either when required.
    
    ## Profiles
    
    `compile`, `assemble-debug`, `targeted-unit-test`, `unit-test-shard`,
    `trusted-tests`, `legacy-tests`, `unit-tests`, `migration-tests`, `lint`,
    `static-guards`, `registered-guard`, `app-check`, `connected-tests`,
    `runner-smoke`, `runner-stall-smoke`.
    
    ## Report
    
    ```markdown
    VALIDATION VERDICT: PASS|FAIL|RUNNING|INFRA_FAILURE|STALE_RESULT
    - run ID: ...
    - profile: ...
    - exit code: ...
    - result/log paths: ...
    - next action: ...
    ```

        private val lifestyleSavingsPromptUseCase = mockk<LifestyleSavingsPromptUseCase>(relaxed = true)
        private val monthlySavingsSweepUseCase = mockk<MonthlySavingsSweepUseCase>(relaxed = true)
    
        private lateinit var goalsFlow: MutableStateFlow<List<SavingsGoal>>
        private val currencyFlow = MutableStateFlow("EUR")
        private val rateFlow = MutableStateFlow(0L)
        private lateinit var viewModel: SavingsGoalsViewModel
    
        @Before
        override fun setup() {
            super.setup()
            coEvery { savingsContributionHistoryRepository.recordContribution(any(), any(), any(), any(), any()) } returns true
    
            every { monthlySavingsSweepUseCase.shouldShowSweepPrompt() } returns false
            every { gamificationEngine.calculateLevel(any()) } answers {
                val totalSaved = invocation.args[0] as Double
                ((totalSaved / 500.0).toInt() + 1)
            }
            every { gamificationEngine.getLevelTitle(any()) } returns "Savings Rookie"
            coEvery { gamificationEngine.aggregateGoalBalances(any(), any()) } answers {
                val goals = invocation.args[0] as List<SavingsGoal>
                MoneyAggregateResult.Available(
                    MoneyAggregate.singleCurrency(
                        amount = goals.sumOf { it.currentAmount },
                        currency = CurrencyCode("EUR"),
                        transactionCount = goals.size,
                        rateBasis = RateBasis.IDENTITY
                    )
                )
            }
    
            coEvery { gamificationEngine.calculateStreak() } returns SavingsStreak(
                currentStreakDays = 0,
                personalBestDays = 0,
                lastSavingsDate = null,
                monthlyContributions = 0,
                totalContributedThisMonth = 0.0
            )
            coEvery { gamificationEngine.getAchievements(homeCurrency = any()) } returns emptyList<SavingsAchievement>()
            coEvery { lifestyleSavingsPromptUseCase.evaluateAndPrompt() } returns null
            coEvery { smartSavingsEngine.calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(any(), any(), any()) } returns
                SmartSavingsComputationResult.NoRecommendation()
            coEvery { smartSavingsEngine.calculateSafeToSaveAmount(any(), any(), any()) } returns SavingsRecommendation(
                safeAmount = 0.0,
                confidence = 0.5,
                impact = "No recommendation",
                source = RecommendationSource.BUDGET_SURPLUS
            )
    
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(emptyList())
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `initial state shows goals list`() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(
                listOf(
                    createGoal(id = 1L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 200.0),
                    createGoal(id = 2L, name = "Vacation", targetAmount = 1500.0, currentAmount = 100.0)
                )
            )
            viewModel = createViewModel()
    
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            val state = viewModel.state.value
            assertEquals(2, state.goals.size)
            assertEquals(300.0, requireNotNull(state.totalSaved), 0.0001)
            assertFalse(state.isLoading)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `add goal updates state`() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(
                listOf(
                    createGoal(id = 1L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 200.0)
                )
            )
            viewModel = createViewModel()
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            viewModel.addGoal(
                name = "New Bike",
                targetAmount = 800.0,
                targetDate = null,
                protectionLevel = GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING
            )
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            val state = viewModel.state.value
            assertEquals(2, state.goals.size)
            assertTrue(state.goals.any { it.name == "New Bike" && it.targetAmount == 800.0 })
            assertEquals("EUR", state.goals.first { it.name == "New Bike" }.currency)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `progress update reflects in UI`() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(
                listOf(
                    createGoal(id = 1L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 100.0)
                )
            )
            viewModel = createViewModel()
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            viewModel.contributeToGoal(goalId = 1L, amount = 150.0)
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            val state = viewModel.state.value
            val updatedGoal = state.goals.first { it.id == 1L }
    
            assertEquals(250.0, updatedGoal.currentAmount, 0.0001)
            assertEquals(250.0, requireNotNull(state.totalSaved), 0.0001)
            coVerify(exactly = 1) {
                savingsContributionHistoryRepository.recordContribution(1L, 150.0, timeProvider.now(), "manual", "EUR")
            }
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `contributeToGoal uses atomic addToGoalAmount`() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(
                listOf(
                    createGoal(id = 1L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 100.0)
                )
            )
            viewModel = createViewModel()
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            // Two contributions in quick succession â€” both should stack via atomic add
            viewModel.contributeToGoal(goalId = 1L, amount = 50.0)
            viewModel.contributeToGoal(goalId = 1L, amount = 75.0)
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            val state = viewModel.state.value
            val updatedGoal = state.goals.first { it.id == 1L }
    
            // 100.0 + 50.0 + 75.0 = 225.0
            assertEquals(225.0, updatedGoal.currentAmount, 0.0001)
            coVerify(exactly = 1) { savingsGoalRepository.incrementSavingsGoalAmount(1L, 50.0) }
            coVerify(exactly = 1) { savingsGoalRepository.incrementSavingsGoalAmount(1L, 75.0) }
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `contributeToGoal with nonexistent goal does not crash`() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(
                listOf(
                    createGoal(id = 1L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 100.0)
                )
            )
            viewModel = createViewModel()
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            // Goal 999 doesn't exist â€” should silently succeed (no-op)
            viewModel.contributeToGoal(goalId = 999L, amount = 50.0)
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            // State should be unchanged
            val state = viewModel.state.value
            assertEquals(1, state.goals.size)
            assertEquals(100.0, state.goals.first().currentAmount, 0.0001)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `empty state when no goals`() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(emptyList())
            viewModel = createViewModel()
    
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            val state = viewModel.state.value
            assertTrue(state.goals.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(0.0, requireNotNull(state.totalSaved), 0.0001)
            assertFalse(state.isLoading)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `loadGoals uses canonical portfolio recommendations without per goal duplication`() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
            val goals = listOf(
                createGoal(id = 1L, name = "Emergency", targetAmount = 1000.0, currentAmount = 200.0),
                createGoal(id = 2L, name = "Vacation", targetAmount = 1500.0, currentAmount = 100.0)
            )
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(goals)
            coEvery { smartSavingsEngine.calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(goals, SmartSavingsEngine.TimeHorizon.MONTH, "EUR") } returns SmartSavingsComputationResult.Available(listOf(
                com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.savings.GoalSavingsRecommendation(
                    goal = goals[0],
                    recommendation = SavingsRecommendation(
                        safeAmount = 25.0,
                        confidence = 0.8,
                        impact = "Good",
                        source = RecommendationSource.BUDGET_SURPLUS,
                        currency = "EUR"
                    )
                ),
                com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.savings.GoalSavingsRecommendation(
                    goal = goals[1],
                    recommendation = SavingsRecommendation(
                        safeAmount = 15.0,
                        confidence = 0.7,
                        impact = "Also good",
                        source = RecommendationSource.SPENDING_PACE,
                        currency = "EUR"
                    )
                )
            ))
    
            viewModel = createViewModel()
            advanceUntilIdle()
    
            val state = viewModel.state.value
            assertEquals(2, state.smartRecommendations.size)
            assertEquals(25.0, state.smartRecommendations.first { it.goal.id == 1L }.recommendedAmount, 0.0001)
            assertEquals(15.0, state.smartRecommendations.first { it.goal.id == 2L }.recommendedAmount, 0.0001)
            coVerify(exactly = 1) {
                smartSavingsEngine.calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(goals, SmartSavingsEngine.TimeHorizon.MONTH, "EUR")
            }
            coVerify(exactly = 0) {
                smartSavingsEngine.calculateSafeToSaveAmount(any(), any(), any())
            }
        }
    
        @org.junit.After
        override fun tearDown() {
            try {
                runTest(testDispatcher) {
                    viewModels.forEach { it.viewModelScope.coroutineContext[kotlinx.coroutines.Job]?.cancelAndJoin() }
                }
            } finally {
                super.tearDown()
            }
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `currency changes invalidate a held recommendation before acceptance`() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
            val goal = createGoal(1L, "Emergency", 1000.0, 200.0)
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(listOf(goal))
            coEvery { smartSavingsEngine.calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(any(), any(), any()) } returns SmartSavingsComputationResult.Available(listOf(
                com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.savings.GoalSavingsRecommendation(
                    goal, SavingsRecommendation(25.0, 0.9, "TEST", RecommendationSource.BUDGET_SURPLUS, "EUR")
                )
            ))
            viewModel = createViewModel()
            advanceUntilIdle()
            val recommendation = viewModel.state.value.smartRecommendations.single()
            currencyFlow.value = "USD"
            advanceUntilIdle()
            viewModel.acceptSmartRecommendation(recommendation)
            advanceUntilIdle()
            coVerify(exactly = 0) { savingsGoalRepository.incrementSavingsGoalAmount(any(), any()) }
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `unavailable savings preserves unknown money and level`() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(listOf(createGoal(1L, "Emergency", 1000.0, 200.0)))
            coEvery { gamificationEngine.aggregateGoalBalances(any(), any()) } returns MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable(
                "DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE", RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE
            )
            viewModel = createViewModel()
            advanceUntilIdle()
            assertNull(viewModel.state.value.totalSaved)
            assertNull(viewModel.state.value.moneyTotalSaved)
            assertNull(viewModel.state.value.userLevel)
            assertTrue(viewModel.state.value.totalSavedResult is MoneyAggregateResult.Unavailable)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `currency changes recompute money without a goals emission`() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
            configureRepositoryWithGoals(listOf(createGoal(1L, "Emergency", 1000.0, 200.0)))
            coEvery { gamificationEngine.aggregateGoalBalances(any(), "USD") } returns MoneyAggregateResult.Available(

            )

            advanceUntilIdle()
            currencyFlow.value = "USD"
            advanceUntilIdle()

            assertEquals(220.0, requireNotNull(viewModel.state.value.totalSaved), 0.0001)
            assertEquals(CurrencyCode.USD, viewModel.state.value.moneyTotalSaved?.currency)
            coVerify { gamificationEngine.aggregateGoalBalances(any(), "USD") }
        }

        private fun configureRepositoryWithGoals(initialGoals: List<SavingsGoal>) {
            goalsFlow = MutableStateFlow(initialGoals)
    
            every { savingsGoalRepository.observeSavingsGoals() } returns goalsFlow
    
            coEvery { savingsGoalRepository.createSavingsGoal(any()) } coAnswers {
                val incoming = invocation.args[0] as SavingsGoal
                val nextId = (goalsFlow.value.maxOfOrNull { it.id } ?: 0L) + 1L
                goalsFlow.value = goalsFlow.value + incoming.copy(id = nextId)
                nextId
            }

                val goalId = invocation.args[0] as Long
                val delta = invocation.args[1] as Double
                val exists = goalsFlow.value.any { it.id == goalId }
                if (exists) {
                    goalsFlow.value = goalsFlow.value.map { goal ->
                        if (goal.id == goalId) goal.copy(currentAmount = goal.currentAmount + delta) else goal
                    }
                }
                exists
            }

        val requestedRateBasis: RateBasis? = null,

        val warningCodes: List<String>,
        val requestedRateBasis: RateBasis,
        val actualRateBasis: RateBasis,

    )
    
    enum class SavingsInputStage {
        CURRENT_SPENDING, PACE_HISTORY, FORECAST_CURRENT, FORECAST_HISTORY,
        RANGE_SPENDING, RECURRING_UPCOMING, PLANNED_UPCOMING, SIMULATOR_HISTORY
    }
    
    /** Request-local collector: no financial amounts, payloads or exception messages. */
    internal class SavingsDecisionQuality(var currency: String) {
        private val inputs = mutableListOf<SavingsInputQuality>()
        private val warnings = linkedSetOf<String>()
        var settingsRateTimestamp: Long? = null
    
        fun requireComplete(stage: SavingsInputStage, input: AnalyticsNormalizationResult) {
            if (input.totalInputCount < input.normalizedExpenses.size ||
                input.includedExpenses.size != input.normalizedExpenses.size) {
                fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_TRANSACTION_COUNTS)
            }
            val codes = (input.warnings.map { it.type.name } +
                input.normalizedExpenses.mapNotNull { it.qualityWarning?.name }).distinct()
            inputs += SavingsInputQuality(
                stage, input.totalInputCount, input.normalizedExpenses.size, input.excludedCount,
                codes, RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                if (input.normalizedExpenses.all { CurrencyCode.parse(it.originalCurrency) == CurrencyCode.parse(currency) })
                    RateBasis.IDENTITY else RateBasis.TRANSACTION_DATE,
                input.latestRateTimestamp
            )
            try {
                input.requireCompleteMoneyInput(currency)
            } catch (error: MoneyDisplayUnavailableException) {
                warnings += error.reasonCode.name
                throw error
            }
        }
    
        fun recordUpcoming(stage: SavingsInputStage, count: Int, excluded: Int, codes: List<String>, identity: Boolean) {
            if (count < 0 || excluded !in 0..count) fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_TRANSACTION_COUNTS)
            inputs += SavingsInputQuality(
                stage, count, count - excluded, excluded, codes.distinct(),
                RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE, if (identity) RateBasis.IDENTITY else RateBasis.LATEST_AVAILABLE, null
            )
        }
    
        fun requireForecast(result: MonteCarloResult?) {
            // Null is the simulator's valid no-data contract; callers retain their conservative fallback.
            if (result == null) return
            result.metadata.historicalMoneyQuality?.let { quality ->
                if (quality.totalInputCount < 0 || quality.includedInputCount < 0 || quality.excludedInputCount < 0 ||
                    quality.includedInputCount.toLong() + quality.excludedInputCount != quality.totalInputCount.toLong()) {
                    fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_TRANSACTION_COUNTS)
                }
                inputs += SavingsInputQuality(
                    SavingsInputStage.SIMULATOR_HISTORY, quality.totalInputCount, quality.includedInputCount,
                    quality.excludedInputCount, quality.warnings.map { it.type.name }.distinct(),
                    quality.requestedRateBasis, quality.actualRateBasis, quality.latestRateTimestamp
                )
                if (quality.quality != ConversionQuality.COMPLETE ||
                    quality.excludedInputCount > 0 || quality.warnings.isNotEmpty()) {
                    fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE)
                }
            }
            if (CurrencyCode.parse(result.displayCurrency) != CurrencyCode.parse(currency)) {
                fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.DISPLAY_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE)
            }
            if (listOf(result.percentile50, result.percentile75, result.confidence.score).any { !it.isFinite() } ||
                result.percentile50 < 0.0 || result.percentile75 < result.percentile50 ||
                result.confidence.score !in 0.0..1.0) {
                fail(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_AMOUNT)
            }
        }
    
        fun fail(reason: MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode): Nothing {
            warnings += reason.name
            throw MoneyDisplayUnavailableException(reason)

    import io.mockk.coEvery
    import io.mockk.coVerify
    import io.mockk.every
    import io.mockk.mockk
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
    import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
    import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
    import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
    import org.junit.Test
    
    class SavingsGoalRepositoryCurrencyTest {
        private val dao = mockk<SavingsGoalDao>()
        private val barrier = mockk<DatabaseWriteBarrier>(relaxed = true)
        private val repository = SavingsGoalRepository(barrier, dao)
    
        @Test
        fun `created goals preserve computation currency and provenance after repository round trip`() = runTest {
            val stored = MutableStateFlow(emptyList<com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.SavingsGoal>())
            every { dao.getAllGoals() } returns stored
            coEvery { dao.insertGoal(any()) } answers {
                val entity = firstArg<com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.SavingsGoal>()
                stored.value = stored.value + entity
                entity.id
            }
            val goals = listOf("USD", "EUR", "GBP").mapIndexed { index, currency ->
                SavingsGoal(index + 1L, "Goal $index", 200.0, 40.0, 1000L,
                    GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, currency, "EXPLICIT_HOME_CURRENCY", 500L)
            }
            for (goal in goals) assertEquals(goal.id, repository.createSavingsGoal(goal))
            assertEquals(goals, repository.observeSavingsGoals().first())
            assertEquals(goals, repository.getSavingsGoals())
            assertEquals(listOf("USD", "EUR", "GBP"), stored.value.map { it.currency })
            coVerify(exactly = 3) { barrier.checkWritesAllowed("SavingsGoalRepository.createSavingsGoal") }
        }
    
        @Test
        fun `legacy assumption remains explicitly legacy on reads and deletion`() = runTest {
            val entity = com.yourname.expensetracker.data.database.entity.SavingsGoal(
                id = 9L, name = "Legacy", targetAmount = 100.0, currentAmount = 30.0,
                currency = "EUR", currencyAssumption = "LEGACY_DEFAULT", createdAt = 500L
            )
            every { dao.getAllGoals() } returns MutableStateFlow(listOf(entity))
            coEvery { dao.deleteGoal(any()) } returns Unit
            val goal = repository.getSavingsGoals().single()
            assertEquals("EUR", goal.currency)
            assertEquals("LEGACY_DEFAULT", goal.currencyAssumption)
            repository.deleteSavingsGoal(goal)
            coVerify(exactly = 1) { dao.deleteGoal(entity) }
            coVerify(exactly = 1) { barrier.checkWritesAllowed("SavingsGoalRepository.deleteSavingsGoal") }
        }
    }

    package com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.savings
    
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.CurrencyAssumption
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money.CurrencyCode
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.model.SavingsGoal
    
    /** Matching currency labels are not evidence of a legacy goal's denomination. */
    object SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy {
        fun knownCurrencyOrNull(goal: SavingsGoal): CurrencyCode? {
            val hasKnownProvenance = when (goal.currencyAssumption) {
                "EXPLICIT", "EXPLICIT_HOME_CURRENCY" -> true
                else -> !CurrencyAssumption.fromSerializedName(goal.currencyAssumption).isUncertain
            }
            return CurrencyCode.parse(goal.currency)
                ?.takeIf { hasKnownProvenance && it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
        }
    
        fun isUnfinished(goal: SavingsGoal): Boolean = goal.currentAmount < goal.targetAmount
    
        fun isRecommendationEligible(goal: SavingsGoal, homeCurrency: CurrencyCode): Boolean =
            isUnfinished(goal) && knownCurrencyOrNull(goal) == homeCurrency
    
        fun hasUnknownActiveGoals(goals: List<SavingsGoal>): Boolean =
            goals.any { isUnfinished(it) && knownCurrencyOrNull(it) == null }
    }

        /**
         * Calculate risk buffer from Monte Carlo uncertainty.
         * Uses the spread between p75 and p50 as a conservative uncertainty buffer.
         */
        private fun calculateRiskBuffer(
            monteCarloResult: com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.forecasting.MonteCarloResult?,
            spentToDate: Double,
            knownUpcoming: Double,
            budgetAmount: Double,
            currentDayOfMonth: Int,
            daysRemaining: Int
        ): Double {
            if (monteCarloResult == null) {
                val safeCurrentDay = currentDayOfMonth.coerceAtLeast(1)
                val currentDailySpend = spentToDate / safeCurrentDay
                val projectedRemainingSpend = currentDailySpend * daysRemaining.coerceAtLeast(0)
                val baselineBuffer = maxOf(
                    knownUpcoming * 0.15,
                    projectedRemainingSpend * 0.20,
                    budgetAmount * 0.03
                )
                val maxFallbackBuffer = maxOf(knownUpcoming, budgetAmount * 0.25)
                return baselineBuffer.coerceIn(0.0, maxFallbackBuffer)
            }
    
            // Risk buffer = p75 - p50 (uncertainty in the upper range)
            val buffer = monteCarloResult.percentile75 - monteCarloResult.percentile50
    
            // Apply a cap to prevent overly conservative estimates
            val maxBuffer = monteCarloResult.percentile50 * 0.3 // Max 30% of median projection
    
            return buffer.coerceIn(0.0, maxBuffer)
        }
    
        /**
         * Distribute safe sweep amount across active goals proportionally
         * based on urgency (how far from target).
                periodStart = now,
                periodEnd = now,
                effectiveLimit = budgetAmount
            )
        }
    
        private fun monteCarloResult(p50: Double) = MonteCarloResult(
            percentile10 = p50,
            percentile25 = p50,
            percentile50 = p50,
            percentile75 = p50,
            percentile90 = p50,
            probabilityUnderBudget = null,
            budgetAmount = null,
            spentToDate = 0.0,
            knownUpcoming = 0.0,
            confidence = SimulationConfidence(0.8, ConfidenceLevel.HIGH, "test"),
            metadata = SimulationMetadata(0, 0, 0, 0.0, 0.0, 0, now),
            displayCurrency = "EUR"
        )
    }

    class SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicyTest {
        private fun goal(currency: String, provenance: String) = SavingsGoal(
            1L, "Goal", 100.0, 0.0, null, GoalProtectionLevel.WARNING, currency, provenance, 0L
        )
    
        @Test
        fun uncertainAndUnrecognizedProvenanceNeverProvesDenomination() {
            for (currency in listOf("EUR", "USD", "GBP")) {
                for (provenance in listOf("LEGACY_DEFAULT", "UNKNOWN", "", "ASSUMED_HOME_CURRENCY", "ASSUMED_LEGACY_EUR", "SECRET unknown")) {
                    val goal = goal(currency, provenance)
                    assertNull(SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.knownCurrencyOrNull(goal))
                    assertTrue(SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.hasUnknownActiveGoals(listOf(goal)))
                    assertFalse(SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.isRecommendationEligible(goal, CurrencyCode(currency)))
                }
            }
        }
    
        @Test
        fun supportedConfirmedCurrenciesRemainKnownAndOnlyAllocateSameCurrency() {
            for (currency in listOf("EUR", "USD", "GBP")) {
                for (provenance in listOf("EXPLICIT", "EXPLICIT_HOME_CURRENCY", "USER_CONFIRMED", "PARSED_FROM_SOURCE")) {
                    val goal = goal(currency, provenance)
                    assertEquals(CurrencyCode(currency), SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.knownCurrencyOrNull(goal))
                    assertTrue(SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.isRecommendationEligible(goal, CurrencyCode(currency)))
                    assertFalse(SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.isRecommendationEligible(goal, CurrencyCode.CHF))
                }
            }
        }
    
        @Test
        fun invalidCurrencyIsUnknownEvenWithExplicitProvenance() {
            for (currency in listOf("", "SECRET invalid", "ZZZ")) {
                assertNull(SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.knownCurrencyOrNull(goal(currency, "EXPLICIT")))
            }
        }
    
        @Test
        fun completedGoalsAreNotAllocationInputsButTheirDenominationRemainsUnknown() {
            val legacy = goal("EUR", "LEGACY_DEFAULT").copy(currentAmount = 100.0)
            assertFalse(SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.hasUnknownActiveGoals(listOf(legacy)))
            assertFalse(SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.isRecommendationEligible(legacy, CurrencyCode.EUR))
            assertNull(SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.knownCurrencyOrNull(legacy))
            assertFalse(SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.hasUnknownActiveGoals(emptyList()))
        }
    }

    package com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.core.money
    
    import com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.currency.SupportedCurrency
    
    /**
     * Type-safe wrapper for ISO 4217 currency codes.
     *
     * Replaces raw `String` currency codes in domain models to prevent
     * invalid or missing currency codes from propagating silently.
     *
     * Use [CurrencyCode.parse] for untrusted input (returns null on invalid codes).
     * Use [CurrencyCode] constructor directly only for known-valid codes.
     */
    @JvmInline
    value class CurrencyCode(val code: String) : Comparable<CurrencyCode> {
    
        init {
            require(code.length == 3) { "Currency code must be 3 letters: '$code'" }
            require(code.all { it in 'A'..'Z' }) { "Currency code must be uppercase ASCII: '$code'" }
            require(code.none { it.isDigit() }) { "Currency code must not contain digits: '$code'" }
        }
    
        override fun compareTo(other: CurrencyCode): Int = code.compareTo(other.code)
    
        override fun toString(): String = code
    
        companion object {
            val EUR = CurrencyCode("EUR")
            val USD = CurrencyCode("USD")
            val GBP = CurrencyCode("GBP")
            val JPY = CurrencyCode("JPY")
            val CHF = CurrencyCode("CHF")
            val CAD = CurrencyCode("CAD")
            val AUD = CurrencyCode("AUD")
            val SEK = CurrencyCode("SEK")
            val NOK = CurrencyCode("NOK")
            val DKK = CurrencyCode("DKK")
            val PLN = CurrencyCode("PLN")
            val CZK = CurrencyCode("CZK")
            val HUF = CurrencyCode("HUF")
            val RON = CurrencyCode("RON")
            val BGN = CurrencyCode("BGN")
            /**
             * Croatian Kuna â€” legacy currency replaced by EUR on 2023-01-01.
             * CURR-13: Marked as legacy/inactive. New expenses should not be
             * created in HRK. Use [com.yourname.expensetracker.domain.currency.SupportedCurrency.HRK]
             * which has `isActive = false`.
             */
            val HRK = CurrencyCode("HRK")
            val ISK = CurrencyCode("ISK")
    
            /** All supported currency codes matching the SupportedCurrency enum. */
            val ALL_SUPPORTED = SupportedCurrency.values().map { CurrencyCode(it.code) }.toSet()
    
            /**
             * Parse a currency code from untrusted input.
             * Returns null if the code is not a valid 3-letter ISO currency.
             */
            fun parse(input: String?): CurrencyCode? {
                if (input.isNullOrBlank()) return null
                val upper = input.trim().uppercase()
                if (upper.length != 3) return null
                if (!upper.all { it in 'A'..'Z' }) return null
                return try {
                    CurrencyCode(upper)
                } catch (e: IllegalArgumentException) {
                    null
                }
            }
    
            /**
             * Parse or fallback to a default currency code.
             * Use this when null is not acceptable but you want safe parsing.
             */
            fun parseOr(input: String?, fallback: CurrencyCode): CurrencyCode =
                parse(input) ?: fallback
    
            /**
             * Get the symbol for this currency code from SupportedCurrency, or
             * return the raw code if unknown.
             */
            fun symbolFor(code: CurrencyCode): String =
                SupportedCurrency.fromCode(code.code)?.symbol ?: code.code
        }
    }
    
    /** Extension to convert a String to CurrencyCode safely, returning null on invalid input. */
    fun String?.toCurrencyCodeOrNull(): CurrencyCode? = CurrencyCode.parse(this)
    
    /** Extension to convert a String to CurrencyCode with fallback. */
    fun String?.toCurrencyCodeOr(fallback: CurrencyCode): CurrencyCode = CurrencyCode.parseOr(this, fallback)

    4. Do not claim tests passed unless actually run.
    5. Do not mark work complete unless gates passed.
    6. If work is partial, use `pending`, `partial`, `blocked`, or `conditional`.
    
    ## Output format
    
    ```markdown
    ## Handoff Summary

        suspend fun calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(
            goals: List<SavingsGoal>,
            timeHorizon: TimeHorizon = TimeHorizon.MONTH,
            homeCurrency: String
        ): SmartSavingsComputationResult {
            val targetCurrency = CurrencyCode.parse(homeCurrency)?.takeIf { it in CurrencyCode.ALL_SUPPORTED }
                ?: return SmartSavingsComputationResult.Unavailable(
                    reasonCode = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_TARGET_CURRENCY.name,
                    metadata = SavingsDecisionQuality(homeCurrency).snapshot(unavailable = true)
                )
            val quality = SavingsDecisionQuality(homeCurrency)
            if (SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.hasUnknownActiveGoals(goals)) {
                return SmartSavingsComputationResult.Unavailable(
                    reasonCode = MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_SOURCE_CURRENCY.name,
                    metadata = quality.snapshot(unavailable = true).copy(
                        warningCodes = listOf(MoneyDisplayUnavailableReasonCode.INVALID_SOURCE_CURRENCY.name)
                    )
                )
            }
            val incompleteGoals = goals.filter { SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.isRecommendationEligible(it, targetCurrency) }
    
            if (incompleteGoals.isEmpty()) {
                return SmartSavingsComputationResult.NoRecommendation(
                    metadata = SavingsDecisionQuality(homeCurrency).snapshot()
                )
            }
    
            val portfolioRecommendation = try {
                calculatePortfolioSafeToSaveAmount(
                    sampleGoal = incompleteGoals.first(),
                    timeHorizon = timeHorizon,
                    homeCurrency = homeCurrency,
                    quality = quality
                )
            } catch (error: CancellationException) {
                throw error
            } catch (error: MoneyDisplayUnavailableException) {
                    ?: return@launch
                if (SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.knownCurrencyOrNull(goal) == null) return@launch
                if (expectedCurrency != null && expectedCurrency != goal.currency) return@launch
                if (recommendation != null && (recommendation !in _state.value.smartRecommendations ||
                        recommendation.goal != goal ||
                        recommendation.currency != currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first() ||
                        recommendation.rateTimestamp != currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().first())) return@launch
                if (recommendation != null) {
                    val result = smartSavingsEngine.calculatePortfolioRecommendationsResult(
                        goals, SmartSavingsEngine.TimeHorizon.MONTH, recommendation.currency
                    )
                    if (result !is SmartSavingsComputationResult.Available) {
                        _state.update { it.copy(smartRecommendations = emptyList(), smartComputationResult = result) }
                        return@launch
                    }
                    val current = result.recommendations.firstOrNull { it.goal.id == goalId } ?: return@launch
                    if (!current.recommendation.isAvailable || current.goal != goal ||
                        SavingsGoalCurrencyPolicy.knownCurrencyOrNull(current.goal) == null ||
                        current.recommendation.moneySafeAmount != recommendation.moneyRecommendedAmount ||
                        recommendation !in _state.value.smartRecommendations ||
                        recommendation.currency != currencySettingsRepository.homeCurrency().first() ||
                        recommendation.rateTimestamp != currencySettingsRepository.lastRateUpdate().first()) return@launch
                }
                if (savingsGoalRepository.observeSavingsGoals().first().firstOrNull { it.id == goalId } != goal) return@launch
                val wasAdded = savingsGoalRepository.incrementSavingsGoalAmount(goalId, amount)
                if (wasAdded) {
                    savingsContributionHistoryRepository.recordContribution(
                        goalId = goalId,
                        amount = amount,
                        currency = goal.currency,
                        source = "manual"
                    )
                    loadGamification()
                }
            }
        }

    function Assert-SafeTestFilters {
        param([object[]]$Filters)
        if ($null -eq $Filters -or $Filters.Count -eq 0) { throw "E_TEST_FILTERS_EMPTY" }
        foreach ($filter in $Filters) {
            if (-not $filter -or ([string]$filter) -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9_.$*?\-]+$') {
                throw "E_INVALID_TEST_FILTER"
            }
        }
    }
    
    function Get-ShardFilters {
        param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name)
        if ($Name -notmatch '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,63}$') { throw "E_INVALID_SHARD" }
        $config = Read-ValidationConfig -Path $script:ShardConfigPath
        $entry = $config.shards.PSObject.Properties[$Name]
        if ($null -eq $entry) { throw "E_UNKNOWN_SHARD" }
        $filters = @($entry.Value.filters)
        Assert-SafeTestFilters -Filters $filters

    ## Behavior changed
    
    - Shared savings policy accepts supported currencies only with explicit provenance:
      EXPLICIT, EXPLICIT_HOME_CURRENCY, USER_CONFIRMED or PARSED_FROM_SOURCE.
      LEGACY_DEFAULT, unknown/unrecognized/blank and assumed currencies remain unknown,
      even if their stored label equals home currency. No persistence defaults changed.
    - Unknown active unfinished goals make smart/sweep computation Unavailable with
      controlled INVALID_SOURCE_CURRENCY before zero-budget/underspend shortcuts.
      Mixed explicit+unknown portfolios are not silently allocated as partial portfolios.
      Sweep outside its recommendation window remains an intentional no-computation path.
    - Explicit foreign goals remain unsupported allocation inputs, not relabeled or
      converted. Empty/finished-only portfolios can still have no recommendation;
      completed unknown balances remain unavailable for portfolio valuation/achievements.
    - Gamification uses the same policy for portfolio balances and completion history
      attribution. Unknown zero balances cannot create a known zero total or level.
      Count-based goal creation and event-day streaks are not denomination-dependent.
      Known goal balances can still unlock money thresholds even when historical events
      cannot establish an unlock date; the existing no-fabricated-date contract is retained.
    - Smart presentation filters unknown/finished goals. Smart and sweep acceptance
      recheck current goal/provenance and home/rate settings before writes, including
      settings or repository changes without collector emissions. Manual quick-add
      rejects unknown denomination as well.
    - Narrow GoalCard adjustment hides monetary progress/completion/quick-add for
      unknown currency instead of presenting the legacy label as verified money.
      No goal repair/confirmation flow was invented.
    - Existing successful arithmetic fixtures are now explicitly denominated; monetary
      weights, caps, rounding and assertions are unchanged. The focused golden savings
      oracle fixture was updated for the same reason.
